65952.recognize_zh: 七格組合圖：低倍（A）直腸病灶的黏膜下有巨大、形狀不規則的淋巴濾泡結節（geographic hyperplasia），CD20（C）瀰漫陽性，CD10（D）只標記生發中心，而 BCL2（E）在生發中心陰性、濾泡間區陽性，代表反應性濾泡增生；EBER ISH（F、G）見散在陽性細胞，符合 HIV 相關 EBV 陽性濾泡增生。
features: Panel A: low-power colorectal mucosal biopsy with a large submucosal and lamina propria lymphoid nodule composed of irregular, variably sized follicles
Panel B: expanded follicles with reactive-appearing germinal centers and interfollicular small lymphocytes
Panel C: CD20 diffusely highlights the B-cell nodule
Panel D: CD10 restricted to germinal centers, which retain well-defined outlines
Panel E: germinal centers are BCL2 negative while surrounding mantle and interfollicular cells are positive
Panels F and G: EBER ISH shows scattered positive nuclei of small to large cells, more concentrated in germinal centers at higher power
65952.describe_en: Colorectal biopsy shows an extensive lymphoid proliferation in the lamina propria and submucosa composed of large, irregular, geographic follicles with reactive-appearing germinal centers and expanded interfollicular zones. CD20 highlights the B-cell follicles, and the germinal centers are CD10 positive and BCL2 negative, supporting reactive rather than neoplastic follicles. EBER in situ hybridization shows scattered positive small and large lymphoid cells focally concentrated within germinal centers, without sheets of EBV-positive large cells. In a patient with HIV and with polytypic plasma cells and a high polarized Ki-67 index as reported, findings are consistent with HIV-associated EBV-positive florid follicular hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are back-to-back with attenuated mantles, lack polarization and tingible body macrophages, and are usually BCL2 positive in germinal centers, unlike the BCL2-negative germinal centers here.
MALT lymphoma shows sheets of monocytoid B cells colonizing follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and light chain restriction, whereas plasma cells here are polytypic.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or plasmablastic lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show diffuse sheets of EBER-positive large cells effacing architecture, rather than scattered EBER-positive cells within preserved follicles.
HHV8-positive Castleman shows regressed germinal centers with LANA-1 positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone, and HHV8 was negative here.

65952.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL2; ISH: EBER

65824.recognize_zh: 兩張薄層血片各見一個新月形寄生蟲：A 的配子體凹面仍附著淡色、弧形的紅血球殘膜（Laveran's bib）；B 為較成熟的新月形配子體，中央可見染色質與色素。新月形配子體為惡性瘧（P. falciparum）特徵。
features: Panel A: crescent-shaped purple parasite with a pale arc of the host red cell membrane still stretched across its concave side
Panel B: mature crescent-shaped gametocyte with rounded ends and central chromatin and dark pigment
Both parasites exceed the diameter of adjacent red cells
No ring forms or schizonts evident in these fields
Background shows stain precipitate and a scratch artifact (panel A), and crenated red cells (panel B)
65824.describe_en: Two thin peripheral blood smear fields each show a crescent-shaped Plasmodium gametocyte. In panel A, the remnant of the host red cell membrane is visible as a pale arc bridging the concave border of the parasite; in panel B, a mature crescent shows centrally located chromatin with dark malarial pigment. Both parasites are longer than surrounding red cells, and no asexual stages are identified in these fields. There is background stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes.

ddx.vs: P. vivax gametocytes are round and fill an enlarged red cell with Schüffner stippling rather than being crescent-shaped.
P. malariae gametocytes are round, compact, and occupy a normal-sized red cell with coarse pigment.
Sickle cells lack chromatin, cytoplasm and pigment and are uniformly hemoglobin-colored.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate overlying a red cell
ddx.vs: Precipitate is refractile, varies in plane of focus, and lacks the organized crescent with chromatin and pigment.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes — crescent-shaped parasites longer than a red cell, one with a remnant red cell membrane (Laveran's bib)
pearls_zh: 考法：A 圖考官會指凹面那條淡色弧線問「這是什麼」：宿主紅血球殘膜，稱 Laveran's bib；B 圖問配子體中央暗色顆粒：hemozoin（瘧色素）。
新月形配子體為 P. falciparum 專一特徵；P. vivax、P. ovale、P. malariae、P. knowlesi 的配子體皆為圓形或卵圓形。
P. falciparum 感染的紅血球大小不增大、可見多重感染與 appliqué（accolé）ring、Maurer's clefts；P. vivax/ovale 則紅血球變大並有 Schüffner's dots。
配子體在症狀出現後約 1–2 週才於周邊血出現，因此單純看到配子體不代表急性重症，但仍需在其他視野找 ring forms 計算 parasitemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 A 圖染料沉澱或刮痕當成寄生蟲，或把新月形當成 sickle cell；真正配子體有組織化的新月外形、染色質與色素，沉澱物則折光、焦距不一且無結構。

quiz.q: A 圖寄生蟲凹面上那條淡色弧狀膜稱為什麼？這種新月形時期是哪一種瘧原蟲的特徵？
quiz.a: Laveran's bib（紅血球殘膜）；P. falciparum gametocyte

65760.recognize_zh: 厚血片中一條很長的線蟲幼蟲，呈平順的大弧度彎曲，體內核排列鬆散、可分辨，一端有淡粉紅鞘突出，另一端尾部變細且末端無核；夜間採血加上嗜酸性球增多，符合班氏絲蟲（Wuchereria bancrofti）微絲蚴。
features: Very large elongated nematode larva, many times the length of a leukocyte, lying in graceful smooth curves without kinks
Body column filled with discrete, loosely arranged, individually distinguishable nuclei
Pale pink sheath visible as a detached flap beyond the blunt end
Opposite end tapers to a slender tail that is free of terminal nuclei
Thick smear background with lysed red cells and scattered leukocyte debris
65760.describe_en: Thick peripheral blood smear shows a large sheathed microfilaria lying in smooth, gentle curves. The body contains a column of loosely packed, individually discernible nuclei, the sheath is visible projecting beyond one end, and the tapering tail end lacks terminal nuclei. The background shows lysed red cells without other parasites. In a patient from an endemic area with eosinophilia and a nocturnal blood sample, findings are consistent with Wuchereria bancrofti microfilaremia.

ddx.vs: B. malayi microfilariae are kinked with tightly packed, overlapping nuclei and two separate terminal nuclei at the tail tip, and the sheath stains bright pink with Giemsa.
Loa loa is sheathed but shows irregular coils, densely packed nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip, and diurnal periodicity.
Mansonella microfilariae are small, unsheathed and have nuclei extending to a bluntly rounded tail tip.
Cotton or plant fibers lack the internal column of stained nuclei and the defined cephalic and caudal ends seen here.

exam.answer_en: Wuchereria bancrofti microfilaria on thick smear — sheathed larva in smooth curves with discrete nuclei and nucleus-free tapering tail
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指蟲體一端突出的淡色膜問「這是什麼」：sheath（鞘）；再指尾端問「有無核」：W. bancrofti 尾端無核，是與 Brugia（2 顆分離末端核）、Loa loa（核延伸到尾尖）鑑別的關鍵。
W. bancrofti 形態口訣：有鞘、曲線平順（graceful curves）、體核分散可數、頭端空間短、尾端無核；Brugia 則彎折多（kinky）、體核擁擠。
無症狀微絲蚴血症常因嗜伊紅性球增多被發現；夜間採血（約 22:00–02:00）才容易在血中找到 W. bancrofti。
治療：依是否合併 onchocerciasis 或 Loa loa 選擇 DEC、albendazole、ivermectin 組合；doxycycline 可針對共生菌 Wolbachia 殺死成蟲。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 Brugia malayi：Brugia 蟲體呈多處扭折、體核擠在一起、尾端有 2 顆分開的核且鞘在 Giemsa 染成亮粉紅；本例曲線平順、核分散、尾端無核。

quiz.q: 這條有鞘、曲線平順、尾端無核的微絲蚴最可能是哪一種？應在何時採血？
quiz.a: Wuchereria bancrofti；夜間（約晚上 10 點至凌晨 2 點）

65696.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大型淋巴球的核呈多葉花瓣狀（flower/clover-leaf），胞質中等淡藍；流式證實是 CD20+ 的單株 B 細胞，而淋巴結切片為大型細胞片狀、MUM1 陽性的 DLBCL，這些花瓣細胞並非 ATLL。
features: Blood: large lymphoid cells with deeply lobulated, flower petal- or clover-leaf-like nuclei and moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Nuclear chromatin moderately condensed; lobes radiate around a central point
Lymph node: diffuse sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and mitoses
MUM1: diffuse strong nuclear positivity in the large cells
Flow (CD3 vs CD4): small CD4+/surface CD3-negative aberrant T-cell population (2.91%)
Genomic panels: EBV DNA 122 IU/mL, microarray showing 1p cnLOH and gains of 3q and 10p, NGS table with TNFRSF14 and BLM variants
65696.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large atypical lymphoid cells with multilobated, flower petal-like nuclei and moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm. The concurrent lymph node biopsy shows diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli that are diffusely MUM1-positive, while flow cytometry reveals only a small residual CD4+/CD3-negative aberrant T-cell population. Shared copy-number changes and TNFRSF14/BLM variants in blood and node link the circulating flower-like cells to the nodal lymphoma. Findings are consistent with leukemic non-germinal center diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with flower-like morphology arising in the setting of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are CD4+/CD25+ T cells in HTLV-1-positive patients, whereas these cells are CD20+ clonal B cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and a CD4+/CD7-negative/CD26-negative T-cell phenotype.
AITL cells are CD4+ TFH T cells (PD-1, CXCL13) and rarely show floral lobation; here the lobated cells are B cells.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma or other small B-cell lymphoma with cleaved nuclei
ddx.vs: Leukemic FL cells are small with cleaved notched nuclei and CD10+, not large multilobated CD10-negative cells.

65696.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: MUM1; flow; genomics

65568.recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓都是單一型態的芽細胞，切片中芽細胞成片取代骨髓並夾雜吞噬細胞；CD34 陽性、BCL6 核強陽性而 PAX5 陰性，加上 BCL6 break-apart FISH 紅綠訊號分離，表示這是帶 BCL6 重排的 AML 而非 B 細胞腫瘤。
features: Peripheral blood with medium-sized blasts showing round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm (panel A)
Marrow biopsy with diffuse sheets of monotonous blasts and scattered pale macrophages imparting a starry-sky-like pattern (panel B)
BCL6 break-apart FISH with one fused signal and separated red and green signals indicating rearrangement (panel C)
Blasts diffusely membranous CD34 positive (panel D) and strongly nuclear BCL6 positive (panel E)
PAX5 negative in blasts, excluding B-lineage (panel F)
65568.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy is replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous blasts with interspersed macrophages. By immunohistochemistry, the blasts are CD34 positive and show strong nuclear BCL6 expression, while PAX5 is negative, arguing against a B-cell neoplasm. Break-apart FISH shows a split BCL6 signal pattern. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with BCL6 rearrangement, in this case co-occurring with KMT2A::MLLT10.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are PAX5/CD19/CD79a positive and usually TdT positive, whereas these blasts are PAX5 negative and MPO positive by flow.
These can show a starry-sky pattern and BCL6 expression but are CD34 negative and express CD20/PAX5 with MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia with KMT2A rearrangement only
ddx.vs: Morphology and phenotype overlap, and BCL6 rearrangement is identified only by FISH or genome mapping.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma/other small round blue cell tumors of childhood
ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumors are CD34/MPO negative and express lineage markers such as desmin, synaptophysin, or CD99 with FLI1.

65568.stain: Giemsa; IHC: CD34, BCL6, PAX5; FISH: BCL6

65504.recognize_zh: 黏液胭脂紅（mucicarmine）染色下，淋巴結中大片泡沫狀區域裡滿是圓形小空泡，每個空泡中央的菌體外圍有洋紅色的莢膜環；下方仍可見藍紫色的殘存淋巴細胞。莢膜被 mucicarmine 染成紅色，是 Cryptococcus 與其他酵母菌區分的關鍵。
features: Large sheet of pale, bubbly/vacuolated tissue replacing lymph node parenchyma
Numerous round yeast forms with carmine-red (mucicarmine-positive) capsular rings of variable size
Clear halo-like spaces around many organisms representing the capsule
Interspersed histiocytes with bland nuclei among the organisms
Residual dense lymphoid cells at the lower edge of the field
65504.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy stained with mucicarmine shows extensive replacement of the parenchyma by a gelatinous, vacuolated area containing numerous round yeast forms of variable size. The yeast capsules stain carmine red and are surrounded by clear halos, with scattered histiocytes in between; residual lymphoid tissue is present at the lower edge. Findings are consistent with cryptococcal lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are small, uniform, intracellular and mucicarmine negative.
Blastomyces can be weakly mucicarmine positive but shows broad-based budding and thick double-contoured walls without a wide capsule.
Rhinosporidium forms very large sporangia (up to 300 µm) with endospores and occurs in nasal mucosa, not small budding yeasts in lymph node.
Signet ring cells have intracellular mucin displacing a crescentic nucleus and are keratin positive, whereas these mucicarmine-positive structures are extracellular organisms without nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Cryptococcal lymphadenitis (mucicarmine, 400X) — gelatinous replacement by yeasts with carmine-red capsules
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍下泡沫狀「soap-bubble」區域中見紅色莢膜，考官問染色名稱與其專一性；答 mucicarmine 染 polysaccharide capsule，為 Cryptococcus 特徵。
組織中大量莢膜物質形成膠狀病灶，發炎反應可很輕微（免疫低下者尤甚）。
血清與 CSF cryptococcal antigen（lateral flow assay）敏感度高；CSF 可做 India ink，但敏感度較低。
播散性病人需腰椎穿刺測開放壓，顱內壓升高需反覆引流。
exam.pitfall_zh: 泡沫狀空泡區易被誤為脂肪或 Whipple/分枝桿菌感染的泡沫組織球；mucicarmine 陽性莢膜與空泡中央菌體是區分關鍵，Blastomyces 偶可弱陽性但為厚壁寬基出芽。

quiz.q: 此 mucicarmine 染色中紅色環狀構造是什麼？指向哪種真菌？
quiz.a: Polysaccharide capsule；Cryptococcus（neoformans/gattii）。

65376.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中散在四顆單核細胞，核圓、染色質均勻，細胞質淡藍且邊緣呈毛絨狀細突起（hairy projections），視野中沒有正常分葉核白血球，提示淋巴球增多且以毛狀細胞為主，符合毛狀細胞白血病。
features: Small to intermediate mononuclear cells with round to slightly oval nuclei
Homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli at this magnification
Pale blue-grey cytoplasm with irregular, fringe-like circumferential projections
Atypical cells are the only leukocytes in this field; red cells are normocytic with preserved central pallor
Occasional platelets present; low magnification limits fine nuclear detail
65376.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-intermediate power shows scattered atypical lymphoid cells as the predominant leukocyte population in this field. The cells are small to intermediate in size with round nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fine, irregular hair-like projections around the cell periphery. Red cells are normocytic and platelets are present; no blasts are identified. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells of hairy cell leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometric immunophenotyping (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes show short, often polar villi and more clumped chromatin and are CD103/CD25-negative, whereas hairy cells have circumferential projections and are CD103+CD25+CD123+.
HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E, unlike the nucleolus-inconspicuous classic hairy cells here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm, block-like clumped chromatin and smudge cells, lacking the abundant fringed cytoplasm of hairy cells.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — hairy cells as the predominant leukocytes, with fringe-like cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看整體白血球組成，考官問為何視野中只剩毛細胞：嗜中性球與單核球低下，腫瘤細胞相對為主。
與 SMZL 區分：SMZL 的 villous lymphocyte 突起集中於一端或兩端（polar），CD103 多陰性、CD25 陰性或弱、annexin A1 陰性。
與 CLL 區分：CLL 細胞小、染色質塊狀（soccer-ball）、常伴 smudge cells，表型 CD5+/CD23+。
流式 CD200 在 HCL 強表現，在 SMZL 多為陰性或弱，是有用的輔助標記。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下毛狀邊緣不明顯時易誤判為 CLL 或反應性淋巴球；需高倍確認環周毛狀突起，再以流式 CD103/CD25/CD11c 確認。

quiz.q: SMZL 的 villous lymphocyte 與毛細胞的突起分布有何不同？
quiz.a: SMZL 突起集中於一端或兩端（polar）；HCL 為環周分布

65312.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍中央可見一顆大型組織球，細胞質充滿粉紅色、細長針狀或條紋狀的包涵物，核被擠向一側，背景為大量未成熟顆粒球系細胞，配合 CML 診斷為假性高雪氏細胞。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm packed with pink, needle-like to striated fibrillary inclusions
Small, compressed eccentric nucleus
A second, less distinct striated histiocyte adjacent below
Background of immature myeloid cells with oval vesicular nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Scattered eosinophilic granulocytes and segmented forms
65312.describe_en: High-power bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm filled with pink, needle-like to striated fibrillary material and a small eccentric nucleus, with a second similar cell nearby. The background consists of densely packed immature and maturing granulocytic cells, including eosinophilic forms. No organisms are evident. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia; crystal-storing histiocytosis is less likely given the myeloid background.

ddx.vs: Crystal-storing histiocytes contain rhomboid or needle-shaped immunoglobulin crystals with light-chain restriction in a plasma cell or lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm.
Gaucher cells look identical but occur without a BCR::ABL1-positive myeloproliferative background and are confirmed by enzyme assay.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes appear striated but are acid-fast positive.

65184.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中血小板數量增加且有不少大型血小板；骨髓切片巨核細胞明顯增生，體積大、核過度分葉（staghorn 樣），加上 IGV 定序截圖顯示 MPL 基因座 G>C 變異（約 25% 等位頻率，W515S），支持原發性血小板增多症。
features: Peripheral blood: increased platelets with frequent large platelets; red cells largely normochromic with mild anisocytosis
Bone marrow biopsy: megakaryocytic hyperplasia with large megakaryocytes having abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei, loosely scattered
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with preserved fat, no sheets of blasts
IGV sequencing view of MPL (chr1:43,815,009) showing a G>C substitution in about 25% of reads (448 of 1761), corresponding to MPL W515S
65184.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows thrombocytosis with many large platelets. The bone marrow biopsy shows megakaryocytic hyperplasia composed of large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei, dispersed among otherwise unremarkable trilineage hematopoiesis without overt fibrosis or increased blasts in this field. Next-generation sequencing (IGV display) reveals a G>C substitution in MPL at codon 515 in approximately 25% of reads, corresponding to W515S. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia driven by a noncanonical MPL W515S mutation, missed by targeted W515L/K PCR.

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis shows normal-sized, normally lobated megakaryocytes without clustering of giant hyperlobated forms, and no clonal driver mutation.
Pre-PMF shows hypercellularity with granulocytic proliferation and tight clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei rather than dispersed staghorn forms.
5q- syndrome may present with thrombocytosis but has small hypolobated (monolobated) megakaryocytes and macrocytic anemia.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This shows ≥15% ring sideroblasts on iron stain and dyserythropoiesis, whereas iron stores were decreased here without ring sideroblasts.

65120.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞的核呈環狀，中央有一個清楚的圓形透亮孔洞，像甜甜圈（donut/ring nucleus）；旁邊有正常分葉的嗜中性球與淋巴球可作對照，這種環形核是發育異常（dyspoiesis）的表現。
features: Arrowed cell is a medium-sized leukocyte with a ring-shaped (donut) nucleus surrounding a central round clear hole
Nuclear chromatin is moderately condensed and lacy, with a continuous nuclear rim around the hole
Moderate amount of pale grey-blue cytoplasm without prominent granules
Comparison cells in the field: a segmented neutrophil, a band/monocytoid cell at left, and a lymphocyte at right
Background RBCs show mild rouleaux-like overlap; platelets present
65120.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered leukocytes including a segmented neutrophil and a lymphocyte. The arrowed cell has a moderate amount of pale grey-blue cytoplasm and a ring-shaped nucleus with a central, sharply circumscribed clear hole, the so-called donut or ring nucleus. The nuclear chromatin is moderately condensed without nucleoli. Ring nuclei are a nonspecific dysplastic change and may be seen in myelodysplastic and myeloproliferative neoplasms, after G-CSF or chemotherapy, and in some reactive states; findings are consistent with a donut (ring) nucleus.

ddx.dx: Overlapping RBC or platelet on a nucleus
ddx.vs: Superimposed cells show an RBC-coloured or granular object lying on top of the chromatin, whereas a true donut nucleus has a clear hole with a continuous chromatin rim in the same focal plane.
Vacuoles are usually multiple and extend into cytoplasm with irregular margins, while a ring nucleus has a single central hole enclosed entirely by nuclear material.
Pseudo-Pelger cells are hypolobated with bilobed or round dense nuclei, another dysplastic change but without a central aperture.

64928.recognize_zh: 箭頭處的紅血球幾乎被一個圓形、實心的寄生蟲填滿，胞質內散佈金褐色瘧色素（hemozoin），一側有粉紅色染色質團，不見分裂成裂殖子，符合間日瘧配子體（gametocyte）。
features: Round, compact parasite nearly filling a slightly enlarged red cell
Diffusely scattered golden-brown malarial pigment (hemozoin)
Eccentric condensed magenta chromatin mass
No segmentation into merozoites (not a schizont)
Surrounding erythrocytes normocytic; scattered platelets
64928.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows normocytic erythrocytes with scattered platelets. One slightly enlarged red cell is almost completely occupied by a round, unsegmented parasite containing abundant dispersed golden-brown pigment and an eccentric chromatin mass. No merozoites are identified, excluding a mature schizont. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax gametocyte.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum gametocytes are crescent or banana-shaped and distort the red cell, unlike this round gametocyte filling an enlarged cell.
A schizont contains 12-24 discrete merozoites with clumped pigment, whereas this parasite shows a single chromatin mass and no segmentation.
P. malariae gametocytes are similar in shape but fill a normal-sized or small red cell and lack Schüffner stippling; species confirmation may need PCR.
Babesia forms are small pleomorphic rings or tetrads without hemozoin pigment.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax gametocyte — round compact parasite nearly filling a slightly enlarged red cell, with scattered brown hemozoin and no merozoites
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆圓形實心寄生蟲問時期，答 gametocyte；要說出與 schizont 的差別：無分裂成多個 merozoites、只有單一染色質團。
Hemozoin（malaria pigment）為寄生蟲分解血紅素的產物，呈金褐至黑色；在白血球內看到 hemozoin 也提示瘧疾感染。
P. vivax gametocyte 為圓形，P. falciparum gametocyte 為香蕉／新月形，這是 thin smear 物種鑑別最常考的點之一。
Gametocytes 是傳播給 Anopheles 蚊子的時期；primaquine 對 gametocytes 亦有作用，但 vivax 根治主要目標是 hypnozoites。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 mature trophozoite 或 schizont；gametocyte 圓形緻密、色素分散且只有一團染色質，schizont 則可見多個分離的 merozoite 染色質點。

quiz.q: 箭頭處幾乎填滿紅血球、帶褐色色素且未分裂成 merozoites 的圓形寄生蟲是哪個時期？與 P. falciparum 同時期的形狀差在哪？
quiz.a: Gametocyte；vivax 為圓形，falciparum 為香蕉／新月形。

64736.recognize_zh: 腫瘤切片中細胞呈瀰漫、單調的片狀排列，核圓且多偏位、染色質粗，胞質中等量呈嗜雙色，形態接近漿細胞；在此解析度下核周淡染區（hof）不易確認，需以 CD138 與輕鏈染色佐證為漿細胞瘤。
features: Diffuse, patternless sheet of monomorphic round cells
Round, often eccentric nuclei with coarse, dark chromatin
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Minimal intervening stroma with few thin-walled vessels and scattered red cells
Perinuclear hof not clearly resolvable at this magnification
64736.describe_en: H&E section of the intracranial and calvarial mass shows a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monomorphic round cells with minimal stroma. The cells have round, frequently eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and a moderate amount of amphophilic cytoplasm; a perinuclear hof is suggested but not clearly resolved at this magnification. Significant pleomorphism is not evident. The morphology is suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm (plasmacytoma), which is confirmed by diffuse CD138 positivity in the accompanying immunostain; light-chain restriction and marrow evaluation for myeloma are recommended.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (including primary CNS lymphoma)
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, are CD20 positive, and CNS lymphoma is typically angiocentric and intraparenchymal.
Meningioma is dural-based but shows syncytial whorls, psammoma bodies and intranuclear pseudoinclusions and is EMA and SSTR2A positive rather than CD138 and light-chain restricted.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell or neuroendocrine carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinomas show nuclear molding, cohesive nests and keratin or synaptophysin positivity.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli and a high Ki-67 index, often EBER positive.

64480.recognize_zh: 室溫培養的菌落以乳酸酚棉藍（lactophenol cotton blue）染色，可見細長有隔的無色菌絲，以及一顆表面帶指狀突起的圓形大分生孢子（tuberculate macroconidium），這是莢膜組織胞漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）黴菌相的特徵。
features: Thin, hyaline, septate, branching hyphae forming a loose mycelial network
A single large spherical thick-walled macroconidium with regular knob-like (tuberculate) surface projections
Small smooth round microconidia along or near hyphae
Lactophenol cotton blue wet mount of room-temperature (mold phase) culture; no host cells present
64480.describe_en: Lactophenol cotton blue preparation from a fungal culture incubated at room temperature shows thin, hyaline, septate branching hyphae. A large, round, thick-walled macroconidium bearing evenly spaced finger-like surface projections (tuberculate macroconidium) is present, together with scattered small smooth microconidia. This is the mould phase of a thermally dimorphic fungus; the findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum, and confirmation by conversion to the yeast phase, DNA probe/PCR or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sepedonium produces similar tuberculate macroconidia but is not thermally dimorphic, lacks microconidia and fails Histoplasma DNA probe/antigen confirmation.
Blastomyces mould shows only small oval 'lollipop' conidia on short conidiophores without large tuberculate macroconidia.
T. marneffei mould forms brush-like penicilli and a diffusible red pigment rather than tuberculate macroconidia.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasma capsulatum mould phase (lactophenol cotton blue) — septate hyphae with tuberculate macroconidia and microconidia
pearls_zh: 考法：乳酸酚棉藍染色問「帶指狀突起的大分生孢子是什麼、哪種菌」；答 tuberculate macroconidium，Histoplasma capsulatum。
Thermally dimorphic：25–30°C 為黴菌相（此圖），37°C 與組織內為小型酵母（約 2–4 µm），常見於巨噬細胞內。
培養黴菌相的分生孢子具高度感染性，實驗室需在 biosafety cabinet 操作，懷疑時應告知檢驗室。
播散性感染快速診斷：尿液/血清 Histoplasma antigen；骨髓抹片或切片（GMS）直接看到細胞內酵母。
嚴重播散性感染治療首選 liposomal amphotericin B，之後以 itraconazole 維持；常見於 HIV CD4 低下病人。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Sepedonium 混淆：兩者都有 tuberculate macroconidia，但 Sepedonium 非雙型性、無法轉為酵母，Histoplasma DNA probe 或抗原檢測陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中表面帶指狀突起的圓形大孢子叫什麼？此菌在 37°C 會轉為哪種型態？
quiz.a: Tuberculate macroconidium（Histoplasma capsulatum）；轉為小型酵母（yeast phase）。

64672.recognize_zh: 滑膜切片低倍下可見多個被擴張的絨毛狀突起，內部塞滿背靠背、邊界不清的淋巴濾泡（A，插圖為小裂核的 centrocytes）；免疫染色中濾泡呈 CD20、CD10 強陽性且 BCL2 陽性（B–D），CD3 只在濾泡間（E），指出這是濾泡性淋巴瘤而非類風濕關節炎的反應性濾泡。
features: Panel A: synovium with markedly expanded villous fronds effaced by crowded, back-to-back nodular lymphoid proliferation; inset shows monotonous small cleaved cells (centrocytes) without tingible body macrophages
Panel B: diffuse strong CD20 positivity in follicles and much of interfollicular tissue
Panel C: CD10 strongly highlights numerous closely packed neoplastic follicles, with negative intervening stroma
Panel D: BCL2 is strongly expressed in the follicles (follicles stain darker than interfollicular areas)
Panel E: CD3-positive T cells are confined mainly to interfollicular regions, outlining CD3-negative follicles
64672.describe_en: Sections of synovium show expanded villous fronds diffusely infiltrated by a crowded nodular lymphoid proliferation composed of closely packed, back-to-back follicles; at high power the follicles consist of monotonous small cleaved centrocytes without evident tingible body macrophages or polarization. Immunohistochemistry shows the follicular cells to be CD20-positive, strongly CD10-positive and BCL2-positive, with CD3-positive T cells largely restricted to interfollicular areas. The co-expression of CD10 and BCL2 in germinal center-type follicles is diagnostic of neoplastic follicles. Findings are consistent with involvement of the synovium by follicular lymphoma in a patient with rheumatoid arthritis.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia in rheumatoid synovitis
ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are well separated, polarized with tingible body macrophages and intact mantles, and are CD10-positive but BCL2-negative.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma (MALT-type) with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL cells are CD10-negative and BCL2-positive, with colonized residual germinal centers showing CD10+ BCL2- remnants, unlike uniformly CD10+ BCL2+ follicles.

ddx.dx: Rheumatoid nodule or lymphoid aggregates without germinal centers
ddx.vs: Non-neoplastic aggregates are mixed T and B cells without CD10+ follicular centers and do not efface villous architecture.
DLBCL shows sheets of large centroblasts or immunoblasts with loss of follicular architecture, whereas here the follicles are composed of small centrocytes.

64672.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL2, CD3

64416.recognize_zh: 胸水中大型異型細胞核大、有核仁、細胞質嗜鹼並有空泡，部分腫瘤細胞內包著另一顆細胞或其碎片（細胞吞噬、cannibalism），右下還有立體成團的細胞群，符合轉移性肺癌。
features: Large atypical cells with high N:C ratio, enlarged irregular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli
Cell-in-cell arrangements: tumor cells engulfing other cells or nuclear fragments, compressing the host nucleus into a crescent
Cytoplasmic vacuolation, including a large cell with a central clear zone surrounded by peripheral nuclei (top left)
Three-dimensional cohesive cluster of tumor cells with nuclear molding (bottom right)
Scattered small lymphocytes/leukocytes providing size comparison; clean proteinaceous background
64416.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid (composite of four fields) shows large atypical cells, singly and in cohesive three-dimensional clusters, with high N:C ratios, irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm. Several tumor cells contain engulfed cells or nuclear fragments, displacing the host nucleus into a crescent (cell-in-cell pattern or cannibalism). Background lymphocytes are small by comparison. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma in pleural fluid, in keeping with the known lung primary; immunocytochemistry on a cell block can confirm the origin.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial cells show windows between cells, a two-tone cytoplasm with smooth nuclear contours and small nucleoli, and are calretinin/WT1 positive while negative for MOC31/BerEP4/claudin-4.
Mesothelioma forms knobby morular groups with mesothelial immunoprofile (calretinin, WT1, D2-40) and BAP1 loss, unlike carcinoma markers (TTF-1, claudin-4).
Macrophages have bland oval eccentric nuclei with foamy cytoplasm and CD68/CD163 positivity, lacking nuclear atypia and prominent nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma or leukemia involvement of effusion
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive, lack true cell clusters and cell-in-cell engulfment, and express CD45.

64352.recognize_zh: 指針所指的中性球體積明顯比周圍成熟中性球大，核分成許多小而圓的核葉並向中央聚集成一串葡萄狀（botryoid），這種放射狀多葉核的巨大中性球即為 botryoid neutrophil。
features: Giant neutrophil, clearly larger than adjacent granulocytes
Nucleus with numerous small, rounded lobes clustered centrally in a grape-like (botryoid) arrangement
Condensed, clumped chromatin within individual lobes
Abundant pale pink-gray cytoplasm with fine granules, drawn out into a tail-like extension
Background marrow cells including myelocytes, an eosinophilic myelocyte, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
64352.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant neutrophil (pointer) with abundant pale finely granular cytoplasm and a nucleus composed of numerous small, round lobes clustered centrally in a grape-like configuration, with condensed chromatin. Surrounding marrow elements include myelocytes, an eosinophilic myelocyte, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes without obvious blast increase in this field. Findings are consistent with a botryoid neutrophil, a nonspecific reactive change described in hyperthermia, severe infection (such as scrub typhus) and critical illness.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils have six or more lobes arranged linearly along a chromatin filament, rather than tightly clustered radially, and are accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and giant metamyelocytes.
Macropolycytes are large with increased lobe number but lobes are of normal size and arranged in a chain, not in a compact grape-like cluster.
Apoptotic neutrophils show dense round nuclear fragments with hypereosinophilic shrunken cytoplasm, rather than a large cell with abundant intact granular cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes are much larger with a single contiguous lobulated nucleus and abundant granular platelet-producing cytoplasm.

64224.recognize_zh: 這是非形態學的分子檢驗報告：MYD88 基因 exon 5 偵測到錯義突變 c.794T>C（p.Leu265Pro），結果為 Mutant Type、判讀陽性，支持淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤／Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症。
features: Gene MYD88 (chromosome 3p22.2), exon 5 screened
Missense mutation c.794T>C, p.Leu265Pro (L265P), reference GRCh37 NM_002468.4
Patient sequence reported as Mutant Type
Interpretation: POSITIVE for MYD88 L265P mutation
64224.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic molecular pathology report of PCR-based testing for the MYD88 L265P variant. The patient sample shows the exon 5 missense mutation c.794T>C (p.Leu265Pro) and is reported as positive. MYD88 L265P is present in more than 90% of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia and supports that diagnosis in the setting of an IgM paraprotein and lymphoplasmacytic marrow infiltrate, but it is not entirely specific and must be interpreted with morphology and immunophenotype. The report does not state variant allele fraction or assay sensitivity, which affect interpretation of low-level disease.

ddx.vs: MYD88 L265P occurs in only a minority (under 10%) of marginal zone lymphomas, which lack the typical LPL marrow pattern and IgM paraprotein level.
IgM MGUS also frequently carries MYD88 L265P but lacks a diagnostic marrow lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate and end-organ symptoms.

ddx.dx: Activated B-cell type DLBCL (e.g., primary CNS or testicular)
ddx.vs: These high-grade lymphomas often carry MYD88 L265P but consist of sheets of large B cells rather than small lymphoplasmacytic cells.
IgM myeloma is MYD88 wild type and frequently has t(11;14), with a pure clonal plasma cell population.

exam.answer_en: MYD88 L265P (c.794T>C, p.Leu265Pro) positive — supports lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia
pearls_zh: 判讀法：確認基因、exon、核苷酸與胺基酸改變（exon 5 c.794T>C → p.L265P）及結果為 positive；注意報告有無 VAF 與偵測極限。
頻率：>90% LPL/WM 帶此突變；IgM MGUS 亦常見；MZL 少數；ABC-type DLBCL、primary CNS 與睾丸 lymphoma 也常見。
方法學：allele-specific PCR 比 Sanger sequencing 敏感，適合骨髓低腫瘤比例檢體；陰性不能完全排除 WM。
鑑別與治療：IgM myeloma 為 MYD88 野生型；MYD88 突變者對 BTK inhibitor 反應較好，合併 CXCR4 突變則反應較慢。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤以為 MYD88 L265P 陽性即可確診 WM：此突變不具絕對特異性（IgM MGUS、MZL、ABC-DLBCL 也可陽性），仍需 IgM paraprotein 與骨髓淋巴漿細胞浸潤共同診斷。

quiz.q: 此報告的突變最常見於哪種 B 細胞淋巴瘤？陽性率約多少？
quiz.a: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia；>90%。

64160.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，大量紅血球呈現少數不規則、長短不一的尖刺突起（棘狀紅血球 acanthocytes），並混有規則鋸齒狀的 echinocytes 與小而無中央淡染區的球形紅血球；在服用 alectinib 的肺癌病人，這種瀰漫性棘狀紅血球是藥物相關的表現。
features: Numerous acanthocytes: dense, contracted red cells with few irregular spicules of uneven length and spacing
Admixed echinocytes with regular, evenly spaced short projections
Occasional spherocytes lacking central pallor
Remaining red cells normocytic and normochromic; no schistocytes or red cell fragments
Platelets present and unremarkable; low magnification limits leukocyte assessment
64160.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of acanthocytes with irregularly spaced spicules, accompanied by echinocytes and occasional spherocytes. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and schistocytes are not increased. Platelets appear adequate. Note that the embedded scale bar appears miscalibrated relative to red cell size. In a patient receiving alectinib, findings are consistent with drug-induced (spheroacanthocytic) red cell change.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, regular, evenly distributed projections on cells retaining central pallor, whereas acanthocytes have few irregular spicules on dense cells.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of advanced liver disease
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; separation depends on clinical context (severe liver disease versus alectinib exposure) rather than red cell appearance.
Inherited acanthocytosis is lifelong with neurologic signs or fat malabsorption and low lipoproteins, not newly acquired during ALK inhibitor therapy.
HS shows spherocytes without prominent spiculated forms and a family history, while here acanthocytes predominate and reverse on switching ALK inhibitors.

64032.recognize_zh: 這是血紅素 HPLC 層析圖與峰值表（非形態學圖片），主峰 A0 佔 80.5%、HbA2 2.7%、HbF <0.8%，無異常變異峰，屬正常型態；但要注意 HPLC 正常並不排除以超活體染色才看得到的後天性 HbH。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC chromatogram with a dominant A0 peak at retention time 1.79 min (80.5%)
HbA2 peak at 3.30 min quantified at 2.7% (within normal range)
HbF reported <0.8%
Glycated/minor fractions A1a, A1b, LA1c, A1c (6.8%) and P3 (5.4%) present; two small unknown peaks (0.8% and 0.6%)
No abnormal variant peaks such as HbS, HbE/A2 window elevation or early fast-eluting peaks
64032.describe_en: Hemoglobin HPLC chromatogram with peak table shows a dominant HbA (A0) peak comprising 80.5% of total area, HbA2 of 2.7% and HbF below 0.8%. Minor glycated and adduct fractions (A1a, A1b, LA1c, A1c 6.8%, P3) and two small unidentified peaks under 1% are present, without a variant hemoglobin peak or elevated HbA2 or HbF. This is a normal hemoglobin fraction pattern, arguing against beta-thalassemia trait and common structural variants. Because HbH and small amounts of fast-eluting hemoglobins may be unretained or poorly resolved on this program, a normal result does not exclude acquired HbH disease, which is better demonstrated by supravital staining for HbH inclusions.

ddx.vs: Beta-thalassemia trait shows HbA2 typically >3.5% with microcytosis, unlike the 2.7% here.
HbH appears as a fast-eluting peak near the injection point or may be missed, with HbA2 often low, so HbH inclusion staining or alpha-globin genetic testing is needed.

ddx.dx: Hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin or delta-beta thalassemia
ddx.vs: These show markedly increased HbF, whereas HbF here is <0.8%.

63968.recognize_zh: 組圖中肝臟可見大量髓外造血（成群紅血球前驅細胞及巨核細胞），小腸有黏膜發炎與紫色鈣化灶，而箭頭所指的血管內有核紅血球細胞核變大，含毛玻璃狀嗜酸或雙染性核內包涵體並將染色質推向核膜邊緣，這是微小病毒 B19 的細胞病變效應。
features: Panel a (liver): prominent extramedullary hematopoiesis with clusters of erythroid precursors and a megakaryocyte
Panels b-c (small intestine): mucosal/submucosal inflammation with scattered dark basophilic calcific deposits
Panels c-f (arrows): intravascular nucleated red cells with enlarged nuclei containing glassy amphophilic to eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin
Panel f (chorionic villus): fetal capillary containing an erythroid precursor with a dense intranuclear inclusion
Autolytic change consistent with intrauterine fetal demise limits cellular detail
63968.describe_en: Postmortem sections of the fetus show prominent extramedullary hematopoiesis in the liver, composed of clusters of erythroid precursors with scattered megakaryocytes (a). The small intestine shows mucosal and mural inflammation with multifocal dystrophic calcifications (b, c). Intravascular nucleated red blood cells in the intestine, liver, spleen, and chorionic villi (c-f, arrows) have enlarged nuclei with glassy, homogeneous intranuclear inclusions and peripheral chromatin margination. Background autolysis limits assessment of fine cellular detail. Findings are consistent with fetal parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation by parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: CMV causes cytomegaly of endothelial and epithelial cells with owl-eye intranuclear plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions, whereas parvovirus inclusions are restricted to erythroid precursors without cytomegaly.

ddx.dx: Hydrops due to alloimmune hemolytic disease
ddx.vs: Alloimmunization produces marked erythroblastosis without intranuclear viral inclusions and is associated with a positive DAT and maternal antibody.
HSV shows multinucleation, nuclear molding, and chromatin margination in epithelial cells with necrosis, not inclusions confined to erythroid precursors.
Autolysis produces pyknosis or karyolysis without discrete glassy inclusions with a marginated chromatin rim, and IHC for parvovirus is negative.

63712.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎全是長橢圓形（elliptocyte）與卵圓形（ovalocyte）紅血球，形狀一致、血色素分布均勻，且看不到鐮刀狀或淚滴狀為主的變形，這是遺傳性橢圓形紅血球增多症（hereditary elliptocytosis）的典型血片。
features: Majority of red cells are elliptocytes and ovalocytes with rounded ends and parallel sides
Elliptocytes show a spectrum from mildly oval to markedly elongated (rod-like) forms
Normochromic cells with little or no central pallor visible in the elongated forms
Occasional small fragments and irregular/pear-shaped poikilocytes
Platelets present and unremarkable; no leukocytes in this field
63712.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monotonous population of elliptocytes and ovalocytes comprising the large majority of red cells. The elongated cells have smooth contours with rounded, blunt ends and uniform hemoglobinization; occasional small fragments and irregular poikilocytes are present. No sickle cells, target cells, or significant teardrop cells are seen, and platelets appear adequate. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytic cells with scattered pencil cells and anisocytosis rather than a uniform, well-hemoglobinized elliptocyte population exceeding 25% of red cells.
Myelofibrosis features teardrop cells with a single tapered tail plus a leukoerythroblastic picture, not symmetric rounded-end elliptocytes.
SAO cells are stomatocytic ovalocytes with one or two transverse bars or slits, whereas HE elliptocytes lack central slits.
HPP shows marked microspherocytes, budding fragments and bizarre poikilocytes with very low MCV in addition to elliptocytes.

exam.answer_en: Hereditary elliptocytosis — monotonous elliptocytes and ovalocytes with blunt rounded ends
pearls_zh: 考法：問兩端鈍圓、邊緣平行的形態名稱，並與 sickle cell（兩端尖）、teardrop cell（單尾）區分。
HE 為膜骨架水平交互作用缺陷（α/β-spectrin、protein 4.1）；HS 則是垂直交互作用缺陷（ankyrin、band 3、protein 4.2 等）。
同型或複合異型合子可表現為 hereditary pyropoikilocytosis：嚴重小球性溶血、MCV 極低、紅血球熱不穩定。
Southeast Asian ovalocytosis 為 SLC4A1（band 3）27 bp 缺失，異型合子多無症狀，形態為帶橫裂的卵圓細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為骨髓纖維化的淚滴細胞：teardrop 只有單側尖尾且伴 leukoerythroblastosis，elliptocyte 兩端對稱鈍圓。

quiz.q: 與 HS 相比，HE 是膜骨架哪個方向的交互作用缺陷？
quiz.a: 水平（horizontal）交互作用

63648.recognize_zh: CD138 免疫染色低倍下，整條淋巴結粗針切片幾乎都被細胞膜陽性的細胞片狀佔據，呈蜂巢狀，其間夾雜深棕色無細胞區（沉積物的非特異性著色），顯示漿細胞瀰漫浸潤。
features: Low-power core biopsy with diffuse, strong membranous CD138 staining of sheets of cells
Honeycomb pattern of outlined cell membranes throughout the core
Irregular darker brown amorphous acellular areas, likely nonspecific chromogen trapping in deposited material
Few small clear spaces and vessels; no significant CD138-negative cellular areas
63648.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on the lymph node core biopsy shows diffuse, strong membranous staining of sheets of cells occupying nearly the entire core, confirming an extensive plasma cell infiltrate. Irregular darker brown acellular areas correspond to amorphous deposits and likely represent nonspecific chromogen trapping rather than true cellular staining. Cytologic detail is limited at this low magnification. Findings support a diffuse plasma cell proliferation; clonality assessment by kappa/lambda in situ hybridization is required to distinguish a plasma cell neoplasm from reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: CD138 is also expressed by epithelial cells, so keratin positivity and nested or glandular architecture must be excluded.
These show a CD20-positive clonal B-cell component in addition to CD138-positive plasma cells.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda ISH.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is CD138 positive but composed of large immunoblastic cells with high Ki-67 and frequent EBER positivity.

63584.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中有三顆中型單核細胞，核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀、胞質為一圈深藍嗜鹼性且邊緣略呈毛邊，屬漿細胞樣形態；周邊血中出現多顆此類腫瘤性漿細胞，配合臨床即為漿細胞白血病。
features: Three medium-sized mononuclear cells, larger than small lymphocytes
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Moderate N:C ratio with a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm and slightly irregular, frayed borders
Perinuclear hof and eccentric nuclear placement are subtle in these cells, giving a lymphoplasmacytoid appearance
Background red cells with mild overlapping but no well-formed rouleaux in this thin field; platelet present
63584.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating atypical mononuclear cells with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with slightly irregular borders. The cells have plasmacytoid features, although a distinct perinuclear hof is not evident, and they could be mistaken for lymphocytes on automated or casual review. Red cells show mild overlap without prominent rouleaux in this thin area. In the clinical context, the findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic plasma cells of plasma cell leukemia, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD38/CD138+, CD19-, light-chain restriction) and enumeration (≥5% circulating plasma cells).

ddx.vs: LPL cells are CD19+/CD20+ B cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, whereas neoplastic plasma cells are CD19-/CD20- and CD138+.
Reactive plasmacytoid cells are few, polyclonal and accompanied by other reactive lymphocyte forms, lacking light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Large granular lymphocytes or CLL cells
ddx.vs: LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and CLL cells have scant cytoplasm with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, not deeply basophilic plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Plasmablastic cells are larger with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are often EBV-positive.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia — circulating plasmacytoid cells with clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm in peripheral blood
pearls_zh: 考法：血片中像淋巴球的細胞，考官會問「是淋巴球嗎？」；要看出深藍胞質、粗塊狀染色質，辨識為循環漿細胞。
診斷門檻：IMWG 2021 將 PCL 定義修訂為周邊血循環漿細胞 ≥5%（舊定義為 ≥20% 或絕對值 >2×10⁹/L）。
流式：CD38 強、CD138+、CD19−、CD45 弱或陰性、胞質輕鏈限制；PCL 較常 CD56 陰性，CD20 可陽性。
原發性 PCL 中 t(11;14) 比例偏高，t(11;14) 與 venetoclax 敏感性相關；del(17p) 等高風險異常也常見。
預後差，常合併腎衰竭、高血鈣、LDH 上升；適合者積極誘導後接 autologous HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性漿細胞樣淋巴球或 LPL；PCL 細胞群較單一、CD138+/CD19− 並有輕鏈限制，反應性者為多株且數量少。

quiz.q: 周邊血中這三顆細胞屬於什麼細胞？
quiz.a: Circulating (neoplastic) plasma cells（循環腫瘤性漿細胞）

63328.recognize_zh: 一個成熟外觀的淋巴球，核圓且染色質緻密，右側淡紫色胞質裡有數條彎曲如蚯蚓般的細絲狀包涵體，在 CLL 病人這是少見的胞質包涵體變異。
features: Single mature lymphocyte with round nucleus and dense homogeneous chromatin
Moderate lilac-gray cytoplasm, more abundant than a typical small lymphocyte
Several wavy, curvilinear filamentous inclusions in the cytoplasm
Inclusions are pale-outlined and non-refractile
Background crenated red cells and scattered platelets
63328.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature lymphocyte with a round nucleus, dense chromatin and moderately abundant pale cytoplasm containing several wavy curvilinear filamentous inclusions. Background red cells are partly crenated, and platelets are present. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells harboring filamentous intracytoplasmic inclusions; electron microscopy or immunostaining can characterize the inclusion material.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells show surface cytoplasmic projections at the cell border rather than internal filaments.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with crystal-storing histiocytosis or crystalline inclusions in plasma cells
ddx.vs: Crystal inclusions in plasma cells are rhomboid or needle-like in eccentric-nucleus plasma cells with a perinuclear hof.
Drying artifact produces irregular refractile folds across red cells as well, whereas true inclusions are confined to lymphocyte cytoplasm.

63264.recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的流式雙參數圖：紅色的主要族群位在左上象限，CD43 明亮陽性而 CD19 陰性，右側零星藍點是 CD19 陽性的殘存 B 細胞；CD43+/CD19- 支持異常細胞非 B 細胞系，需配合 CD3 等 T 細胞標記確認 T-LGL。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD43 APC-H7 (y-axis) vs CD19 PE-Cy7 (x-axis)
Dominant red population in Q1: bright CD43 expression, CD19 negative
Sparse light-blue CD19-positive B cells in Q2 and Q4, with variable CD43
Virtually no events in the double-negative quadrant
Marked reduction of B cells relative to the expanded CD43+ CD19- population
63264.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes shows CD43 (y-axis) versus CD19 (x-axis). The predominant population (red) expresses bright CD43 and is negative for CD19, while only a few residual CD19-positive B cells (blue) are present with variable CD43 expression. CD43 is not lineage-specific, but its bright expression on a CD19-negative expanded population, together with CD3 expression shown on companion plots, supports a T-cell population. In context, the findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: CD43+ B-cell neoplasm (e.g., CLL/SLL, mantle cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: These co-express CD43 with CD19/CD20, whereas the neoplastic population here is CD19-negative.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL cells are also CD43+ CD19- but are surface CD3-negative and CD16/CD56-positive, so a CD3 plot is needed to separate them.
Reactive T cells are also CD43+ CD19-, so this plot cannot separate them; persistence, aberrant antigen loss (CD5/CD7) and clonal TCR rearrangement favor T-LGL leukemia.

63072.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中，散在的大型細胞呈清楚、強烈的細胞膜陽性，勾勒出大而淡染的核（LP cell），部分周圍有 CD20 陽性小細胞圍繞；大型腫瘤細胞 CD20 強陽性（而古典何杰金的 HRS 細胞多為陰性）是 NLPHL 的關鍵線索。
features: Numerous scattered large cells with strong, crisp membranous CD20 staining outlining large, pale, vesicular nuclei
Some large CD20+ cells show irregular or lobulated nuclear contours (LP cells)
Smaller CD20-positive lymphocytes and cell fragments cluster around the large cells
Many background small lymphocytes are CD20-negative in this field, suggesting a T-cell-rich microenvironment
No sheet-like growth of large B cells
63072.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on a lymph node section highlights numerous scattered large cells with strong, uniform membranous positivity, outlining large, pale, irregular to lobulated nuclei consistent with lymphocyte-predominant (LP) cells. Smaller CD20-positive cells are admixed around some of the large cells, whereas many of the background small lymphocytes in this field are CD20-negative, indicating a T-cell-rich microenvironment in this area. The large cells do not form confluent sheets. Strong CD20 expression by the neoplastic cells supports nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; a T-cell-rich or diffuse pattern should prompt assessment of the overall architecture and exclusion of T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are usually CD20-negative or weak and heterogeneous, and are CD30+/CD15+ with loss of OCT2/BOB1, unlike the uniformly strong CD20+ LP cells here.

THRLBCL also has scattered large CD20+ cells in a T-cell background but lacks residual CD20+ small B-cell nodules and CD21+ follicular dendritic cell meshworks, so architecture on CD21 and low-power CD20 is decisive.
LRCHL may show nodules of small B cells, but its neoplastic cells are CD30+/CD15+ and CD20-negative or weak, whereas these large cells are strongly CD20+.
PTGC nodules are composed of CD20+ small mantle B cells with dispersed germinal center cells but lack large LP cells rimmed by PD1+ T cells.

exam.answer_en: NLPHL on CD20 IHC — scattered large LP cells with strong membranous CD20 positivity in a T-cell-rich background
pearls_zh: 考法：CD20 染色中指大型強陽性細胞問「支持 NLPHL 還是 cHL」：LP cells CD20 均勻強陽性；HRS 細胞多為陰性或弱而不均。
必搭配的 panel：CD30、CD15（LP 陰性）、OCT2/BOB1（LP 強陽性）、PD1 或 CD57（LP 周圍 T 細胞 rosettes）、CD21/CD23（顯示濾泡樹突細胞網絡以確認結節）。
本區背景小淋巴球多為 CD20 陰性，屬 T 細胞為主區域；若大範圍瀰漫且缺乏 CD21 網絡，需排除 THRLBCL。
治療關聯：LP cells 表現 CD20，rituximab 可用於晚期或復發病人；早期局限病灶常以放射治療為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CD20+ 散在大細胞一律判為 THRLBCL 或 DLBCL；需看低倍架構：NLPHL 保有 CD20+ 小 B 細胞結節與 CD21+ 濾泡樹突細胞網絡。

quiz.q: 這些散在大型細胞 CD20 呈強陽性，最支持哪一種 Hodgkin 淋巴瘤？
quiz.a: NLPHL（LP cells CD20+；cHL 的 HRS 細胞多為 CD20−）

63200.recognize_zh: 一顆中央的嗜中性球被約八顆紅血球呈花瓣狀緊密環繞（rosette），這種排列在其他白血球周圍並不存在，屬於紅血球玫瑰花結現象。
features: Single central neutrophil with a band-to-bilobed, coarsely clumped nucleus
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
About eight red cells arranged radially and tightly apposed to the neutrophil membrane, forming a rosette
Adherent red cells appear deformed/flattened against the leukocyte surface
Photographed from a monitor screen (cursor visible); fine detail is limited
63200.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (photographed from a display screen) shows a neutrophil encircled by a ring of approximately eight erythrocytes adhering to its surface in a rosette configuration. The neutrophil itself shows a band/bilobed nucleus with clumped chromatin and fine cytoplasmic granules, without evident phagocytosed material. No platelet satellitism is seen in this field. In the clinical setting of hypergammaglobulinemia, findings are consistent with red cell rosetting around a neutrophil, likely immunoglobulin-mediated and possibly an in vitro phenomenon.

ddx.vs: Satellitism shows platelets, not intact red cells, ringing the neutrophil and is EDTA-induced with pseudothrombocytopenia.
In erythrophagocytosis the red cells are engulfed within the neutrophil or macrophage cytoplasm rather than attached around its periphery.
LE cells contain a large homogeneous phagocytosed nuclear body within the cytoplasm, which is absent here.
Rouleaux are stacked linear chains of red cells in the background rather than a radial ring around a single leukocyte.

63136.recognize_zh: 中倍下可見大量小淋巴球與漿細胞，混雜著成群淡染、泡沫狀細胞質的大型組織球（右下較明顯），間有纖細膠原化基質，呈 Rosai-Dorfman 病的「淡色組織球與深色淋巴漿細胞交錯」圖樣。
features: Mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells, denser in upper half
Clusters of large pale histiocytes with abundant clear-to-foamy cytoplasm, prominent lower right
Interspersed collagen bands with focal sclerosis
Scattered adipocytes within the lesion
Emperipolesis not clearly resolved at this magnification
63136.describe_en: Sections at intermediate power show a dense mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells alternating with clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale to foamy cytoplasm, set in a collagenous stroma with scattered adipocytes. The alternating pattern of pale histiocyte-rich areas and dark lymphoplasmacytic areas is evident. Emperipolesis is not well resolved at this magnification and is better assessed at high power or on S100 stain. Findings are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD has storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis without sheets of large pale S100+ histiocytes.
IMT features spindled myofibroblasts in fascicles with ALK expression rather than large rounded S100+ histiocytes.
LCH cells are smaller with grooved nuclei and eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive.
Lymphomas show light-chain restricted plasma cells and a monotypic B-cell population without emperipolesis-bearing histiocytes.

63008.recognize_zh: 周邊血中三個相鄰的大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，其中右上方細胞核內有一個淡染、杯口狀的凹陷（cup-like nuclear invagination），像魚嘴般占據核的一部分；這種杯狀核凹陷的母細胞與 NPM1 及 FLT3-ITD 突變的 AML 有關。
features: Cluster of three large blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Cup-like (fish-mouth) pale nuclear invagination occupying a portion of the nucleus in at least one blast
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Adjacent smudged cell and a separate blast-like cell at upper left
Red cells with refractile drying artifact; photograph taken by phone camera limits fine detail
63008.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a group of large blasts with high N:C ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm; at least one blast displays a cup-like nuclear invagination with a pale central indentation. No Auer rods are identified, and a smudge cell is present nearby. Red cells show refractile drying artifact, and image quality limits assessment of nucleoli. In the context of marked leukocytosis with about 85% blasts, the findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia; cup-like blasts should prompt testing for NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with occasional Auer rod bundles and strong MPO, and carry PML::RARA; cup-like blasts are not typically bilobed.
Monoblasts and promonocytes show folded or convoluted nuclei with abundant gray cytoplasm and vacuoles, and are nonspecific esterase-positive.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO-negative and TdT-positive; cup-like morphology correlates with CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative AML.
Drying artifact produces irregular clear zones in many cells and red cells, whereas true cup-like invaginations are a well-defined indentation at least 25% of nuclear diameter in blasts.

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like blasts — large agranular blasts with cup-shaped (fish-mouth) nuclear invagination, associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD
pearls_zh: 考法：指核上淡染凹陷的母細胞，問此形態名稱（cup-like nuclear invagination）與關聯突變（NPM1、FLT3-ITD）。
杯狀母細胞常見 CD34−、HLA-DR− 表型，形態與表型易與 APL 混淆。
NPM1 突變 AML：IHC 可見 NPM1 異常胞質定位（cytoplasmic NPM1）；WHO 5th 不需母細胞 ≥20%，ICC 2022 門檻為 ≥10%。
FLT3-ITD 陽性可在誘導化療加上 FLT3 inhibitor（如 midostaurin）；NPM1 突變且無 FLT3-ITD 屬 ELN 預後較佳組。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 microgranular APL：兩者都常 CD34−/HLA-DR−，但 APL 核為雙葉蝴蝶狀、MPO 強陽性並帶 PML::RARA；杯狀凹陷為核內淡染區而非分葉。

quiz.q: 右上方母細胞核上的淡染凹陷稱為什麼？與哪兩個突變相關？
quiz.a: Cup-like nuclear invagination；NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD

62944.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下，大量小型深染不規則淋巴球與有淡粉紅色豐富細胞質的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）為背景，其間散在少數核較大、染色質空泡狀、帶核仁的大型非典型細胞，這種「少數大細胞淹沒在 T 細胞與組織球中」的比例是 T 細胞/組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Scattered large atypical cells with oval to irregular vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli
Large cells are a minority, dispersed singly rather than in sheets or clusters
Abundant background epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei
Numerous small lymphocytes with dark, slightly irregular nuclei
No well-formed granulomas, eosinophils, or necrosis in this field
62944.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a lymphohistiocytic infiltrate composed of numerous small lymphocytes with dark irregular nuclei and abundant epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Scattered singly dispersed large atypical cells with vesicular, somewhat pleomorphic nuclei and distinct nucleoli are present. No sheets of large cells, granulomas, or necrosis are seen. Because the large cells are sparse and easily overlooked, immunohistochemistry is required; with CD20+/OCT2+ large cells in a CD3-rich background, findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL LP cells sit in nodules with a small B-cell-rich background and CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks, whereas THRLBCL lacks background small B cells.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and absent OCT2/CD20, unlike the strongly CD20+/OCT2+ large cells of THRLBCL.
In PTCL the atypical cells are T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, and any large B cells are EBV-driven bystanders.
Reactive granulomas contain epithelioid histiocytes and small lymphocytes without scattered atypical large B cells.

exam.answer_en: T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma in marrow — scattered single large atypical cells in a background of small T lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指散在的大型核仁明顯細胞，問「背景為何」與要做哪些 IHC（CD20、CD3、CD68）證實少數大細胞為 B 細胞。
THRLBCL 定義：少數（通常 <10%）散在大型 B 細胞，背景大量 T 細胞與組織球，小 B 細胞極少。
常為進展期（骨髓、肝脾侵犯）表現，治療與 DLBCL 相同（R-CHOP 類）。
大型細胞免疫表型：CD20+、BCL6+、EMA 可陽性，CD30−、CD15−；背景 PD-L1 陽性組織球常見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性淋巴組織球浸潤或肉芽腫：大型非典型細胞稀少容易漏看，必須以 CD20 標出散在大型 B 細胞；也要與 cHL 及 NLPHL 區分。

quiz.q: 此骨髓浸潤中背景主要由哪兩種細胞組成？散在的大細胞是什麼細胞系？
quiz.a: 小型 T 淋巴球與上皮樣組織球；大型 B 細胞（THRLBCL）

62880.recognize_zh: 大腸黏膜固有層被密集、單調的小型淋巴球撐開，細胞核小而深染、細胞質稀少，腺窩上皮保存完整、無明顯破壞，符合惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病（indolent T-cell LPD）的形態。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate of small, monotonous lymphocytes
Small round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; no large transformed cells or mitotic activity evident
Scattered admixed eosinophils and histiocytes
Adjacent crypt epithelium intact without obvious lymphoepithelial destruction or necrosis
62880.describe_en: Colonic mucosal biopsy shows marked expansion of the lamina propria by a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Scattered eosinophils and histiocytes are admixed. The crypt epithelium is preserved, without prominent epitheliotropism, crypt destruction, necrosis, or large atypical cells. In the appropriate immunophenotypic and clonality context, findings are consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: MEITL shows medium-sized cells with marked epitheliotropism, CD56 positivity and a high Ki-67 index, whereas this infiltrate is small-celled, non-destructive and indolent.
EATL is composed of pleomorphic medium to large cells with necrosis and ulceration on a background of celiac enteropathy, unlike the bland small cells here.
MALT lymphoma forms lymphoepithelial lesions and is CD20-positive, whereas this infiltrate is CD3/CD8-positive with only rare B cells.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with plasma cells and neutrophils and are polyclonal with a mixed CD4/CD8 profile, whereas this lesion is monotonous, CD8-predominant and clonal by TCR PCR.

62752.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的大型原始細胞（A），多張高倍圖可見一個原始細胞將另一個細胞或紅血球完整包入胞質內（B–E），被吞入的細胞外圍有空泡邊緣，形成「細胞吞噬細胞」（cannibalism）影像；F 為 Sanger 定序顯示 ZMYND11-MBTD1 融合接點。
features: Clusters of large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and fine chromatin (A)
Blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing fine granules
Intact engulfed cells (blasts or other nucleated cells) and a red cell within a clear vacuole in the cytoplasm of host blasts (B-E), compressing the host nucleus to a crescent
Engulfed cells retain distinct nuclear chromatin, excluding simple vacuolation
Sanger sequencing electropherogram showing the ZMYND11 exon 1-12 to MBTD1 exon 3-17 fusion junction (F)
62752.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cohesive-appearing clusters of large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and moderately basophilic, finely granular cytoplasm. Several blasts display cannibalism, with whole nucleated cells or an erythrocyte enclosed within a clear cytoplasmic vacuole that compresses the host nucleus into a peripheral crescent. Sanger sequencing (panel F) demonstrates an in-frame ZMYND11-MBTD1 fusion junction. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with blast cell cannibalism (emperipolesis/phagocytosis) associated with ZMYND11-MBTD1 fusion; lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Also shows monocytic blasts with hemophagocytosis (erythrophagocytosis) by blasts, but is distinguished by KAT6A::CREBBP rearrangement and often coagulopathy.
Phagocytosis is performed by mature, low N:C ratio benign histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm rather than by high N:C ratio blasts.
Tumor cells form cohesive sheets with epithelial features and are cytokeratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Overlapping cells lack a surrounding clear vacuole and do not indent the host nucleus into a crescent.

62688.recognize_zh: 這是 PTLD 的分類文字表而非形態圖：分為非破壞性 PTLD、多形性 PTLD、單形性 PTLD（B 細胞與 T 細胞腫瘤）與典型何杰金淋巴瘤 PTLD，箭頭標示單形性 B 細胞 PTLD 中的漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma）。
features: Text outline of WHO 2016 PTLD categories
Non-destructive PTLDs: plasmacytic hyperplasia, infectious mononucleosis, florid follicular hyperplasia
Polymorphic PTLD

Monomorphic PTLD classified by the lymphoma it resembles: B-cell (DLBCL, Burkitt, plasma cell myeloma, plasmacytoma highlighted with arrow, other) and T-cell (PTCL NOS, hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, other)
Classic Hodgkin lymphoma PTLD
Footnote: indolent small B-cell lymphomas in transplant recipients are not PTLD, except EBV-positive marginal zone lymphomas
62688.describe_en: This figure is a text classification scheme rather than a morphologic image. It lists the WHO 2016 post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder categories: non-destructive PTLDs (plasmacytic hyperplasia, infectious mononucleosis, florid follicular hyperplasia), polymorphic PTLD, monomorphic PTLDs classified according to the B-cell or T-cell neoplasm they resemble, and classic Hodgkin lymphoma PTLD. An arrow highlights plasmacytoma within monomorphic B-cell PTLD, the category of the associated case. Footnotes note that ICD-O codes follow the corresponding neoplasm and that indolent small B-cell lymphomas are excluded except EBV-positive marginal zone lymphomas.

62624.recognize_zh: 高倍下積液細胞塊中的腫瘤細胞很大，核圓或不規則、染色質呈泡狀、核仁明顯，部分核偏心且細胞質偏嗜雙性，呈免疫母細胞／漿母細胞樣，並夾雜多形性大細胞，符合原發性積液淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, many 3-4 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to irregular, sometimes eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin
Prominent single central or multiple nucleoli (immunoblastic/plasmablastic)
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; occasional pleomorphic and multinucleated forms
Scattered apoptotic bodies and admixed red blood cells in a fibrinous background
62624.describe_en: Cell block of effusion fluid at high power shows a dense aggregate of large, discohesive atypical lymphoid cells embedded in fibrin. The cells have round to irregular, occasionally eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and a moderate amount of amphophilic cytoplasm; occasional pleomorphic and multinucleated forms and apoptotic bodies are present. There is no epithelial or mesothelial architecture. The morphology is that of an immunoblastic/plasmablastic high-grade lymphoma, consistent with primary effusion lymphoma in the appropriate context (HHV8 LANA-1+, CD45+, CD30+, CD138+, CD20-).

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma usually presents as a mass (oral cavity, GI) and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative, whereas PEL is effusion-based and LANA-1 positive.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving effusion
ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and is T-cell/ALK marker positive, while PEL is HHV8+ with plasma cell-associated markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic poorly differentiated carcinoma or melanoma
ddx.vs: These are CD45 negative and express keratin or S100/SOX10 respectively, and usually show some cohesion.

exam.answer_en: Primary effusion lymphoma — large pleomorphic immunoblastic/plasmablastic cells with prominent nucleoli in effusion fluid (HHV8+)
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指著核偏心、核仁明顯的大細胞，問細胞分化方向（plasmablastic）與致病病毒（HHV8），常與 plasmablastic lymphoma 比較。
IHC 組合：HHV8 LANA-1+、CD45+、CD138/MUM1+，B 細胞抗原（CD20、CD79a、PAX5）與表面/胞質 Ig 常缺失；EBER 多數陽性。
分子：IG 基因重組呈單株性，可藉此與反應性積液細胞區分；表面標記缺失時分子檢查可協助證明 B 細胞來源。
WHO 5th 將 HHV8 陰性、與體液過多相關的積液型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤另列（fluid overload–associated LBCL），其 CD20 多陽性、預後較佳。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 plasmablastic lymphoma：兩者形態與 CD138+ 表型相似，但 PBL 常形成腫塊（如口腔）、HHV8 陰性；PEL 以積液為主且 HHV8 LANA-1 陽性。

quiz.q: 此積液中的大細胞 CD20 陰性、CD138 陽性，還需哪個病毒標記才能診斷 PEL？
quiz.a: HHV8（KSHV）LANA-1

62560.recognize_zh: PD-L1 染色中，密集的腫瘤細胞大多無明確完整膜染色，棕色訊號主要呈斑片狀、顆粒狀集中在細胞間隙與散在的組織球／基質細胞；這張圖顯示腫瘤細胞 PD-L1 表現低，不支持 PD-L1 高表現的淋巴瘤型別（如 PMBL）。
features: Sheets of medium to large tumor cells with round to oval nuclei, mostly lacking crisp membranous PD-L1 staining
Patchy weak granular staining concentrated in intercellular spaces and interspersed histiocytic/stromal cells
A few scattered cells with stronger cytoplasmic staining in the lower right of the field
Occasional mitotic figures visible within the tumor sheet
62560.describe_en: PD-L1 immunohistochemistry on the diffuse sheets of medium to large tumor cells shows predominantly absent or weak, incomplete staining of the neoplastic cells. Patchy granular positivity is concentrated in intercellular spaces and in interspersed histiocytic and stromal elements, particularly toward one side of the field. Distinguishing weak tumor membrane staining from background immune cell staining is limited at this magnification, but no strong diffuse membranous tumor-cell expression is evident. PD-L1 is not diagnostic for the classification of double-hit lymphoma and is used mainly to consider entities with 9p24.1 alterations or immunotherapy eligibility.

ddx.vs: PMBL typically shows strong membranous PD-L1 in tumor cells due to 9p24.1 alterations, with sclerosis and CD23/MAL expression.
EBV-positive DLBCL often shows high tumor-cell PD-L1 and is EBER-positive.
HRS cells show strong PD-L1 membranous staining in a mixed inflammatory background with CD30/CD15 positivity.

62496.recognize_zh: 脾臟觸摸抹片中大量單一形態的小至中型淋巴球，箭頭指出數顆細胞質豐富、淡灰藍色的大細胞（邊緣區／單核球樣細胞，可能部分為組織球），背景散在嗜中性球與破碎細胞，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Monotonous small-to-medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Arrows mark larger cells with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and oval nuclei (marginal-zone/monocytoid-type cells; histiocytes cannot be excluded)
Scattered neutrophils and occasional crushed/smudged cells with nuclear streaming
No sheets of large blastic cells
62496.describe_en: Touch preparation of spleen shows a dense, monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and a modest rim of cytoplasm. Admixed are scattered larger cells with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and oval nuclei (arrows), consistent with marginal-zone-type cells, although some may represent histiocytes. Occasional neutrophils and crushed cells are present, and large transformed cells are not increased. Findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia is polymorphous with mixed centroblasts, immunoblasts and plasma cells and is polytypic by flow cytometry.
Hairy cells are dispersed singly with circumferential cytoplasmic projections and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1 positive, and HCL involves red pulp without white pulp nodules.
LPL shows a spectrum of plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, frequently MYD88 L265P mutated with IgM paraprotein.

62432.recognize_zh: Ki-67 免疫染色中幾乎每一個腫瘤細胞核都呈棕色陽性，只有少數藍色背景細胞為陰性，增殖指數接近 100%；配合中型單形 B 細胞形態，是伯奇氏淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma）的典型表現。
features: Diffuse nuclear Ki-67 staining in virtually all tumor cells (proliferation index ~100%)
Monotonous population of medium-sized round nuclei
Only rare negative (hematoxylin-counterstained) cells, mainly stromal/background
Diffuse sheet-like architecture without nodularity
No cytoplasmic or membranous staining (appropriate nuclear pattern)
62432.describe_en: Ki-67 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse, strong nuclear staining in a monotonous sheet of medium-sized tumor cells. The proliferation index is estimated at approximately 100%, with only rare unstained background cells. The staining pattern is nuclear and uniform across the field without a zonal or nodular distribution. In the context of a CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2-negative mature B-cell neoplasm with MYC rearrangement, the findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL usually has a Ki-67 index well below 90% with more heterogeneous staining, larger cells, and often BCL2 expression.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Proliferation can also be very high, so separation requires BCL2 expression and FISH for BCL2 (and BCL6) rearrangement.
Lymphoblasts have finer blastic chromatin and express TdT and CD34 while lacking surface immunoglobulin, despite a high Ki-67.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma — Ki-67 proliferation index ~100% in a monotonous sheet of medium-sized B cells
pearls_zh: 考法：給 Ki-67 問增殖指數，接近 100% 且整片均勻陽性要想到 Burkitt lymphoma；需配合 H&E 的 starry-sky 與中型單形細胞。
必考表型：CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2 陰性或弱、TdT−；遺傳為 MYC 與 IG 基因重排，最常見 t(8;14) IGH::MYC，其次 t(8;22)、t(2;8)。
急症：腫瘤生長極快，治療前後都要預防 tumor lysis syndrome（水化、rasburicase 等），並需評估 CNS 侵犯與做 CNS 預防。
Ki-67 高不等於 Burkitt：需 FISH 排除 BCL2 重排，WHO 5th 將同時有 MYC 與 BCL2 重排者歸為 DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements。
Endemic 型幾乎皆 EBV 陽性、好發顎骨；sporadic 型常見腹部（迴盲部）腫塊；immunodeficiency 相關型見於 HIV。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 DLBCL 或 B-lymphoblastic lymphoma：DLBCL Ki-67 通常較低且不均勻、常 BCL2+；lymphoblastic 為 TdT+，Burkitt 為 TdT− 且 Ki-67 近 100%。

quiz.q: 此 Ki-67 染色的增殖指數約多少？最需以哪項檢查確認診斷？
quiz.a: 約 100%；FISH 證實 MYC（IG::MYC）重排，並排除 BCL2 重排

62368.recognize_zh: CD3 染色中寬大的外套層區域幾乎全為藍色陰性，陽性 T 細胞只散在於濾泡間區與生發中心內；與 CD5 在外套層強陽性對照，表示外套層的 CD5 陽性細胞並非 T 細胞。
features: Expanded mantle zones largely CD3-negative
CD3-positive T cells concentrated in interfollicular/paracortical areas (upper right)
Scattered CD3-positive T cells within germinal centers
Monotonous small negative lymphocytes filling the nodules
62368.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 shows that the monotonous small lymphocytes filling the expanded mantle zones are negative. CD3-positive T cells are confined to interfollicular regions and scattered within germinal centers. Compared with the CD5 stain, which labels the mantle zone population, this demonstrates aberrant CD5 expression on non-T (B) cells, supporting mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is also CD3-negative CD5+ but CD23+ LEF1+ with proliferation centers and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Reactive mantles are also CD3-negative, but their B cells lack CD5 co-expression and cyclin D1.

62304.recognize_zh: 中央細胞有豐富淡藍色細胞質，內含多條細長、針狀的粉紅至紫色結晶（類 Auer 小體，Auer-rod-like inclusions），周圍可見多個核偏位、細胞質嗜鹼性的漿細胞，提示漿細胞腫瘤伴結晶性包涵體。
features: Central cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing multiple slender needle-shaped, rod-like crystalline inclusions
Round nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin in the inclusion-bearing cell
Surrounding plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and occasional perinuclear hof
Occasional binucleated or immature-appearing plasma cells
Scattered free rod-shaped crystals in the background near the cells
62304.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. One cell with abundant pale cytoplasm contains numerous slender, needle-like, Auer-rod-like crystalline inclusions; the cell has a round nucleus with coarse chromatin, and its lineage (plasma cell versus crystal-laden histiocyte) cannot be fully resolved on morphology alone. No Auer rods are identified in myeloid precursors. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline (immunoglobulin, often kappa light chain) inclusions; correlation with serum/urine immunofixation, CD138 and light-chain studies, and evaluation for crystal-storing histiocytosis or Fanconi syndrome is suggested.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, whereas these crystals lie in cells with mature plasma-cell or histiocytic chromatin.
Crystal-storing histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive with abundant cytoplasm and small bland nuclei, whereas intracytoplasmic crystals in plasma cells are CD138 positive; IHC separates the two.
Gaucher cells show a wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete needle-shaped crystals and are unrelated to a clonal plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or Mott cells
ddx.vs: Russell bodies and Mott cells contain round globular immunoglobulin inclusions rather than elongated rod-shaped crystals.

62176.recognize_zh: 高倍下右下細胞核呈明顯扭曲、分葉並有凹陷摺痕，細胞質灰藍帶空泡，為前單核球（promonocyte）；左側大細胞核卵圓有線狀摺痕、染色質細緻並見核仁，上方細胞核圓且染色質細緻，符合單核母細胞，屬急性單核球白血病。
features: Large cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and low to moderate N:C ratio
Lower right cell with convoluted, lobulated nucleus showing indentations and folds (promonocyte), with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Left cell with oval nucleus showing a linear nuclear crease, delicate lacy chromatin and a small nucleolus
Upper cell with large round nucleus and finely dispersed chromatin (monoblast-like)
No Auer rods or coarse granules identified
62176.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows three large immature monocytic cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. The upper cell has a large round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin, and the left cell has an oval nucleus with a delicate nuclear fold, lacy chromatin and a small nucleolus. The lower right cell has a convoluted, lobulated nucleus with indentations and vacuolated cytoplasm, characteristic of a promonocyte. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with occasional Auer rod bundles, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monocytic cells are NSE positive and MPO weak/negative.
Mature monocytes have more condensed chromatin without nucleoli and less basophilic cytoplasm than promonocytes, which have delicate folded nuclei and fine chromatin.

AMML contains ≥20% neutrophilic lineage cells with MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells, whereas monoblasts/promonocytes account for ≥80% of leukemic cells in acute monocytic leukemia.

exam.answer_en: Acute monocytic leukemia — monoblasts and promonocytes with folded/convoluted nuclei, delicate chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：要區分 monoblast（圓核、細緻染色質、明顯核仁）、promonocyte（核有摺痕扭曲、細胞質灰藍）與成熟 monocyte；前兩者計為 blast equivalent。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且被 NaF 抑制；monoblast 的 MPO 常為陰性或弱陽性。
Flow：CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4（弱）、CD36、lysozyme；CD34 常陰性。遺傳常見 KMT2A 重排，如 t(9;11)(p21.3;q23.3) MLLT3::KMT2A。
臨床：高白血球血症、牙齦增生、皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）、CNS 侵犯，以及 DIC 與 tumor lysis syndrome 風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把 promonocyte 誤當成熟 monocyte 而低估 blast 比例；promonocyte 染色質細緻、核有精細摺痕，成熟 monocyte 染色質較粗且細胞質有空泡與細顆粒。

quiz.q: 右下核扭曲摺疊、細胞質灰藍帶空泡的細胞是什麼？計算 blast 比例時是否計入？
quiz.a: Promonocyte；是，計為 blast equivalent

62048.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見多個淡粉紅色、由較大多角形細胞構成的結節或蛇行狀區域，與深藍色小淋巴球帶交錯排列，淡染區可能為上皮樣組織球或大細胞聚集，是 NLPHL 變異型或進展時需特別注意的型態。
features: Nodular and serpiginous pale eosinophilic zones composed of larger polygonal cells
Pale zones alternate with dark bands of densely packed small lymphocytes
Pale areas may represent epithelioid histiocyte aggregates and/or confluent large cells; distinction not possible at this power
Effaced architecture without recognizable normal follicles or sinuses
Scattered small vessels; no necrosis or broad fibrous bands
62048.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows effaced architecture with multiple nodular and serpiginous pale eosinophilic zones composed of larger polygonal cells, alternating with dark bands of small lymphocytes. At this magnification the pale zones could represent epithelioid histiocyte aggregates or confluent sheets of large cells, and cytologic detail is insufficient to distinguish them. No necrosis or broad sclerotic bands are seen. In a case of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, this appearance warrants high-power review and CD20/CD68 immunostains to exclude confluent sheets of large B cells indicating progression to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising from NLPHL
ddx.vs: Progression is defined by confluent sheets of large CD20+ B cells, which must be confirmed at high power and by IHC rather than inferred from pale areas at low power.
Reactive epithelioid histiocyte clusters are CD68+ and lack atypical large B cells, occurring in a background of preserved reactive follicles.
NSCHL nodules are separated by birefringent collagen bands and contain lacunar CD30+/CD15+ cells, not the pale histiocyte-rich zones seen here.

ddx.dx: Lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma
