ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma shows diffuse small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes among atypical CD4+ T cells with clonal TCR rearrangement, without CD20+ LP cells.

61984.recognize_zh: 五格免疫染色：大型腫瘤細胞 CD30 呈強烈細胞膜及核旁 Golgi 點狀陽性，ALK 陰性，CD20 陰性，CD3 在大細胞上陰性（只有背景小 T 細胞陽性），CD45 部分弱陽性；CD30 均勻強陽性而 ALK 陰性、合併 T 標記缺失，是乳房植入物相關 ALCL 的關鍵表型。
features: Large pleomorphic tumor cells in a pale, fibrinous-appearing background
CD30: strong, uniform membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern staining of large cells
ALK: negative in tumor cells
CD3: negative in large tumor cells; only scattered small reactive T cells positive
CD20: negative, excluding a B-cell neoplasm
CD45: variable, weak to moderate membranous staining in a subset of cells
61984.describe_en: Panel of immunohistochemical stains on tissue containing large pleomorphic tumor cells. The large cells show strong, uniform membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 staining and are negative for ALK, CD20 and CD3, with CD3 highlighting only scattered small reactive T cells; CD45 shows variable weak to moderate staining. This profile indicates a CD30-positive, ALK-negative lymphoid neoplasm with loss of CD3. Findings are consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma, supporting breast implant-associated ALCL in the setting of a periprosthetic effusion or capsule.

ddx.vs: ALK-positive ALCL shows nuclear and cytoplasmic ALK staining and occurs mostly in young patients, whereas this tumor is ALK-negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30-positive but typically CD45-negative, CD15-positive and weakly PAX5-positive in a mixed inflammatory background.
Carcinoma and melanoma can be large and pleomorphic but are CD45-negative and positive for cytokeratins or SOX10/S100, respectively.
DLBCL cells are CD20- and PAX5-positive, which excludes it here given CD20 negativity.

61984.stain: IHC: CD20, CD3, CD45, CD30, ALK

exam.answer_en: ALK-negative ALCL (breast implant-associated) — uniform strong CD30 with ALK, CD20 and CD3 negative tumor cells
pearls_zh: 考法：五格 IHC 逐一判讀：CD30 膜狀加 Golgi 點狀陽性、ALK 陰性、CD20 陰性、CD3 僅背景小 T 細胞陽性。
ALCL 常喪失 T 細胞抗原（CD3 最常失去），不可因 CD3 陰性就排除 T 細胞腫瘤；可加 CD4、CD43 與 cytotoxic markers。
判讀 CD3 時以背景小淋巴球作為內部陽性對照。
CD30 陽性不等於 ALCL：cHL、embryonal carcinoma 與部分 DLBCL 亦可陽性，需整體表型判讀。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易因 CD3、CD20 皆陰性而誤判為非淋巴腫瘤；CD30 均勻強陽性加上 CD45 部分陽性，支持 T 抗原喪失的 ALCL。

quiz.q: 依此 IHC 組合，腫瘤細胞 CD3 陰性能否排除 T 細胞腫瘤？
quiz.a: 不能；ALCL 常喪失 T 細胞抗原

61920.recognize_zh: CD56免疫染色下，固有層被細胞膜強陽性（棕色）的細胞密集充滿，包圍著完全陰性的腺體，幾乎沒有陰性浸潤細胞；大片CD56陽性確認浸潤為NK細胞，是NK細胞腸病的關鍵染色。
features: Diffuse strong membranous CD56 positivity in nearly all cells of the lamina propria infiltrate
Positive cells are medium-sized, forming sheets that surround and separate negative glands
Glandular epithelium CD56-negative with no intraepithelial positive cells
Gland outlines preserved without destruction
61920.describe_en: CD56 immunohistochemistry on gastrointestinal mucosa shows sheets of medium-sized cells with strong membranous CD56 staining diffusely expanding the lamina propria and encircling negative, structurally intact glands. Intraepithelial positive cells are not seen. The diffuse CD56 expression confirms an NK-cell population. In the context of CD5 negativity, cytoplasmic CD3 positivity, EBER negativity and a non-destructive mucosal pattern, the findings are consistent with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is equally CD56-positive; EBER in situ hybridization (positive in ENKTL, negative in NK-cell enteropathy) and necrosis/angiodestruction separate them.
MEITL is CD56-positive too but shows heavy intraepithelial infiltration, surface CD3/CD8 and clonal TCR rearrangement.
Neuroendocrine tumor cells are CD56-positive but form nests or trabeculae and express cytokeratin, synaptophysin and chromogranin rather than CD2/CD3.

61792.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中紅血球嚴重大小不一、多呈淚滴或拉長的尾巴狀（黃色箭頭），並有明顯中央淡染與標靶細胞；配合小球性貧血與 HbH 帶，符合 HbH disease。
features: Severe anisopoikilocytosis with many teardrop and tailed cells (arrows)
Predominantly microcytic, hypochromic red cells with wide central pallor
Target cells, elongated/ovalocytic forms and small fragments
Rare larger round red cells with less pallor (possible polychromatophilic or ghost-like cells)
Platelets present singly and in small clumps; no nucleated cells in this field
61792.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly abnormal red cell morphology with severe anisocytosis and poikilocytosis. Most red cells are microcytic and hypochromic, with numerous teardrop cells, target cells, elongated forms and fragments; occasional larger rounder cells are present. Platelets appear adequate, and no nucleated red cells or leukocytes are seen in this field. HbH inclusions cannot be assessed on this Romanowsky stain. The findings are consistent with a severe thalassemic red cell picture and, with the electrophoretic HbH fraction, support HbH disease.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but it shows raised HbF and HbA2 without an HbH fast band and typically more NRBCs and stippling.
Shows comparable microcytic targets and poikilocytes but electrophoresis reveals a large HbE fraction rather than HbH.
Teardrops are accompanied by leukoerythroblastosis and giant platelets rather than uniform microcytic hypochromia.
Pencil cells and hypochromic microcytes predominate with few teardrops, low ferritin and no HbH.

61728.recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 CD56 對 CD34 流式圖：綠色異常芽細胞群 CD56 陽性、CD34 陰性，位於右下；紅色正常前驅細胞則為 CD34 亮陽性、CD56 陰性；CD34−/CD56+ 的芽細胞群符合 BPDCN 表現型。
features: Dot plot: CD56-ECD (x-axis) versus CD34-PC7 (y-axis), gated on blasts
Abnormal population (green) CD56-positive (moderate) and CD34-negative
Residual normal progenitors (red) CD34-bright and CD56-negative
Few red events in transition and rare blue lymphoid events negative for both markers
Clear phenotypic separation of neoplastic and normal blast compartments
61728.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD56 versus CD34 gated on blasts shows an abnormal population (green) that is CD56-positive and CD34-negative. Residual normal progenitors (red) are CD34-bright and CD56-negative and are clearly separated from the abnormal cells. Lack of CD34 with CD56 expression on blasts is typical of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, although CD56 may be negative in a minority of cases. Integration with CD4, CD123, HLA-DR and absence of MPO and lineage-specific markers is required.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant CD56
ddx.vs: CD56+ AML blasts generally retain CD34 and/or CD117 with myeloid antigens, unlike these CD34-negative blasts.
NK neoplasms are CD56+/CD34- but express CD2/CD7 and cytotoxic granules and lack CD4 and bright CD123.

61600.recognize_zh: 整片密集排列的中大型腫瘤細胞，細胞膜呈強而一致的 CD138 陽性（棕色蜂巢狀），核圓、部分偏位，顯示腫瘤細胞為漿細胞表型，符合漿母細胞淋巴瘤（plasmablastic lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-to-large, closely packed tumor cells
Strong, uniform membranous CD138 staining in virtually all tumor cells, giving a honeycomb pattern
Round to oval nuclei, some eccentrically placed, with open chromatin
Moderate amounts of cytoplasm with weaker cytoplasmic staining
Thin fibrovascular septa traverse the sheet; no intervening CD138-negative population
61600.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD138 on a tissue section shows a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of medium-to-large neoplastic cells. Virtually all tumor cells show strong, uniform membranous (and weaker cytoplasmic) CD138 expression. The cells have round, often eccentric nuclei with moderate cytoplasm. In the context of a large-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, this supports a plasma-cell immunophenotype and is consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma (EBV-positive by EBER ISH in this case).

ddx.vs: Both are CD138+; myeloma usually has a known M-protein, lytic lesions, marrow involvement and is typically EBV-negative, whereas PBL is often EBER+ in an immunocompromised host or oral/extranodal site.
Also CD138+ with plasmablastic morphology but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK staining and is EBV-negative.
Shares a CD138+/CD20- phenotype but is HHV8 (LANA) positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with plasmablastic features
ddx.vs: Retains CD20/PAX5 expression, whereas PBL lacks or only weakly expresses pan-B-cell markers.

61536.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中許多紅血球變形成不規則、摺疊或邊緣像被咬缺的形狀，部分有透明凹陷區；低倍插圖（箭頭）可見成群變形紅血球與小團聚。這些人工變形在正常背景（中性球型態正常）下，應聯想到冷球蛋白在室溫沉澱所致。
features: Many red cells with irregular, folded, notched or 'bitten' contours and angular projections
Some red cells with sharply demarcated clear indentations or pale spots
Inset (low power): clusters of deformed red cells and small aggregates (arrows) among otherwise round red cells
Morphologically unremarkable segmented neutrophil
No discrete extracellular cryoprecipitate crystals or rouleaux clearly visible in this field
61536.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with irregular, folded and notched contours, angular projections and sharply demarcated clear indentations, giving a pseudo-fragmented or bite-like appearance. The low-power inset shows these deformed red cells clustered in small aggregates (arrows) amid round red cells. A segmented neutrophil is morphologically normal, and no true schistocytes with sharp fragment edges predominate. In the appropriate clinical setting these in vitro changes are suggestive of cryoglobulin precipitation; a smear prepared from blood kept at 37 °C should be reviewed and cryoglobulins measured.

ddx.vs: True schistocytes are small fragments with sharp straight edges and horns accompanied by thrombocytopenia and polychromasia, and they persist on a warmed specimen.
Bite cells show a single smooth semicircular defect with hemoglobin retracted to one side and are accompanied by Heinz bodies on supravital stain.
Cold agglutinins cause red cell agglutination clumps of intact round cells rather than distorted, folded cell shapes, and the DAT is C3-positive.
Echinocytes have 10–30 evenly spaced short blunt spicules around a round cell, not irregular folds and clear indentations.

61472.recognize_zh: 大量紅血球內可見細小、纖細的環狀體（ring form），紅血球大小正常且無 Schüffner 小點，並有多重感染（一顆紅血球內多個環狀體）；中央嗜中性球胞質內有棕黑色瘧色素（hemozoin），支持惡性瘧（P. falciparum）。
features: High parasitemia: numerous erythrocytes contain small, delicate ring forms, many with appliqué (accolé) forms at the RBC margin
Multiply infected erythrocytes, including a cell with several rings, and occasional double-chromatin-dot rings
Infected RBCs are normal in size and shape without Schüffner stippling; no trophozoite enlargement
No mature trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes in this field
Central segmented neutrophil with a brown-black malarial pigment granule in its cytoplasm
Background of scattered platelets; a small dark cell/platelet clump at upper left
61472.describe_en: Peripheral blood thin smear shows a high burden of intraerythrocytic parasites. Numerous normocytic erythrocytes contain small, fine ring forms, frequently multiple per cell, with occasional double chromatin dots and appliqué forms; infected cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling. No late trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes are identified in this field. A neutrophil contains phagocytosed brown-black hemozoin pigment. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with high parasitemia; a parasite percentage should be reported.

ddx.vs: Infected RBCs are enlarged with Schüffner stippling and rings are thicker, with ameboid trophozoites and schizonts usually present, unlike the numerous tiny rings in normal-sized RBCs here.
Early rings can mimic falciparum, but band forms and schizonts with up to 16 merozoites are seen in peripheral blood, and PCR is needed for confirmation.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and tetrads (Maltese cross) and never produces hemozoin pigment, whereas pigment is seen in the neutrophil here.
Superimposed platelets lack a ring of cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot and are not in the same focal plane as the RBC.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria, high parasitemia — multiple fine rings per non-enlarged RBC with double chromatin dots and appliqué forms
pearls_zh: 考法：指著一顆紅血球內 2–3 個 ring 問「哪種瘧原蟲最可能」→ P. falciparum（multiple infection、double chromatin、appliqué 為其特徵）。
受感染紅血球大小正常且無 Schüffner stippling，可與 P. vivax/ovale（紅血球變大、有 Schüffner dots）區分。
報告必須包含 parasitemia %；P. falciparum >10%（WHO 標準）屬重症，應住院給予 IV artesunate。
高 parasitemia 可伴隨溶血、低血糖、急性腎損傷、ARDS；需監測血糖與乳酸。
P. knowlesi 早期 ring 型態可類似 P. falciparum，東南亞旅遊史需考慮並以 PCR 確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為血小板疊在紅血球上或染料沉澱；ring 有清楚的藍色胞質環與紅色 chromatin dot 且位於紅血球平面內，血小板則無環狀結構、周圍常有暈。

quiz.q: 一顆紅血球內出現多個纖細 ring 且紅血球不變大，最可能是哪一種瘧原蟲？報告時必須附上什麼數值？
quiz.a: Plasmodium falciparum；parasitemia（%）

61408.recognize_zh: BCL6 染色低倍（40x）見腫瘤結節內大量細胞核強陽性、周圍間質陰性；高倍（400x）為中大型細胞瀰漫強核染，顯示生發中心表型，這是 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤（BCL6+ 且 MUM1 強陽性）的典型組合之一。
features: Low power (40x): sheets/nodules of tumor with diffuse strong nuclear BCL6 staining, sharply demarcated from negative stromal bands
High power (400x): strong nuclear BCL6 in the majority of medium to large cells
Positive nuclei round to oval, some irregular or cleaved
Scattered negative cells, endothelium and stromal cells
61408.describe_en: BCL6 immunohistochemistry shows strong diffuse nuclear staining in the majority of neoplastic medium to large lymphoid cells, sharply contrasted with negative fibrous septa at low power. The germinal center-type BCL6 expression, in combination with strong MUM1/IRF4 co-expression, is characteristic of large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement. Confirmation of IRF4 rearrangement by FISH is required.

ddx.vs: FL is also BCL6-positive but typically BCL2-positive, MUM1-negative and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS (GCB type)
ddx.vs: GCB-type DLBCL co-expresses BCL6 and CD10 but lacks strong diffuse MUM1 and IRF4 break.
Burkitt lymphoma is BCL6+ but shows medium-sized cells with starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 ~100% and MYC rearrangement.

61344.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向兩顆中型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質少且無顆粒，符合淋巴母細胞；周圍卻有大量帶橘紅色與深色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞，母細胞少而嗜酸性球多，要想到 t(5;14) IL3-IGH 的 B-ALL。
features: Blasts (arrows) of intermediate size with high N:C ratio and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors with orange-red granules, some admixed with immature dark basophilic-staining granules
Mature segmented neutrophil and other myeloid precursors in the background
Blasts are relatively few compared with the prominent eosinophilic component
61344.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered intermediate-sized blasts with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm (arrows). These are admixed with numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes, some containing immature dark-staining granules, along with a segmented neutrophil and other maturing myeloid cells. The eosinophils show no overt dysplasia in this field. The blasts are morphologically consistent with lymphoblasts; in the setting of marked eosinophilia, the findings are suggestive of B-lymphoblastic leukemia with t(5;14)(q31.1;q32.1); IGH::IL3, which requires flow cytometry and cytogenetic or FISH confirmation because the blast count may be low.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 or JAK2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: The eosinophils are clonal with the tyrosine kinase fusion, whereas in t(5;14) B-ALL the eosinophilia is reactive and non-clonal driven by IL-3 from the lymphoblasts.
Blasts are myeloid/monocytic with MPO positivity and the abnormal eosinophils contain large purple-violet granules, rather than CD19+/TdT+ lymphoblasts.
Lacks a TdT-positive B-lymphoblast population on flow cytometry.
Show a maturing spectrum of B-cell precursors with normal antigen expression patterns rather than a phenotypically aberrant blast population.

61280.recognize_zh: 多格組圖：骨髓切片（A）被成片小型母細胞取代，但仍夾有大型、核深染分葉的巨核細胞（背景的真性紅血球增多症）；抹片（B）是核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質極少的淋巴母細胞；免疫染色一個膜染色陽性（C）、一個陰性（D）、一個強核染色陽性（E），支持 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Panel A (BM biopsy, H&E): hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of small to intermediate blasts with scattered large megakaryocytes having hyperchromatic, hyperlobated nuclei
Panel B (aspirate): monotonous lymphoblasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Panel C (IHC): strong membranous staining of most blasts, consistent with a surface B-lineage or precursor marker
Panel D (IHC): blasts negative with only rare scattered positive cells, a pertinent negative lineage marker
Panel E (IHC): diffuse strong nuclear staining of blasts (pattern of TdT or PAX5); specific antibodies are not labeled in the figure
61280.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and diffusely infiltrated by sheets of small to intermediate-sized blasts, with residual large megakaryocytes showing hyperlobated, hyperchromatic nuclei. The aspirate smear shows lymphoblasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates diffuse membranous positivity in one stain, a negative stain, and diffuse nuclear positivity in another; the antibodies are not labeled, so correlation with the original legend and flow cytometry is needed. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia arising in a patient with JAK2 V617F-positive polycythemia vera.

ddx.dx: Myeloid blast phase of polycythemia vera (post-PV AML)
ddx.vs: Far more common progression; blasts are MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 positive rather than CD19/PAX5/TdT positive.
Requires MPO or multiple monocytic markers on the blasts in addition to B-lineage markers, which must be excluded by flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with FGFR1 or JAK2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Can present with lymphoblastic transformation plus MPN features; distinguished by FISH/karyotype for the rearrangement rather than JAK2 V617F.
Hematogones show a maturation continuum by flow (variable CD10/CD20/CD34) and do not form sheets that efface the marrow.

61152.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中，右側有一顆邊界不清、胞質散布粗大深紫色顆粒的細胞，顆粒向四周散開、遮蓋核形，符合循環中的（部分脫顆粒）肥大細胞；旁邊為中性球與淋巴球作對照。
features: Single cell with numerous coarse, dark purple (metachromatic) granules dispersed beyond an ill-defined cell border
Granules obscure nuclear detail; appearance suggests a partly disrupted or degranulating granulated cell
Surrounding leukocytes are unremarkable segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes
Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic without marked poikilocytosis
Low-power field; only one granulated cell identifiable
61152.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows normochromic red cells with several segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes. One cell contains abundant coarse, dark purple metachromatic granules that spill beyond an indistinct cytoplasmic border and obscure the nucleus, consistent with a circulating mast cell rather than a basophil, although distinction is limited at this magnification. A single such cell is insufficient to quantify leukemic involvement; a manual differential and marrow evaluation (mast cells ≥20% in the aspirate) are required. Findings are suggestive of circulating mast cells in the setting of mast cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a segmented nucleus and fewer, larger granules within a well-defined cell outline, whereas mast cells are larger with a round/oval nucleus and densely packed granules.

ddx.dx: Chronic basophilic or myeloid leukemia (CML) with basophilia
ddx.vs: CML shows many basophils together with a left-shifted granulocytic series and BCR::ABL1, not isolated large mast cells.
Crushed neutrophils have fine lilac granules and pale chromatin strands, lacking the dense metachromatic granules of mast cells.

61024.recognize_zh: 視野中大多數紅血球呈淚滴狀，尾端朝向各個不同方向，部分尾巴細長彎曲；隨機方向的尾端可排除抹片製作假象，支持真正的淚滴細胞（dacrocyte），常見於原發性骨髓纖維化。
features: Numerous dacrocytes with single tapered tails pointing in random directions
Several cells with long, thin or slightly curved tails
Admixed ovalocytes and elongated poikilocytes; occasional fragmented/irregular cell at left edge
Red cells normochromic with preserved central pallor
No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or platelets identified in this field
61024.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells whose tails are oriented in random directions, together with ovalocytes and occasional irregular fragments. Red cells are normochromic with preserved central pallor. No leukocytes or nucleated red cells are present in this field to evaluate for a leukoerythroblastic picture. These findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis or infiltration, such as primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Artifactual teardrops all point in one direction along the spreading axis, whereas these tails are randomly oriented.
Thalassemia smears are dominated by microcytic, hypochromic target cells with only occasional teardrops.

ddx.dx: Myelophthisis from metastatic tumor or granulomas
ddx.vs: Blood morphology overlaps; bone marrow biopsy distinguishes infiltrating tumor/granulomas from MPN megakaryocytic atypia with reticulin fibrosis.
MAHA features schistocytes (helmet cells, triangular fragments) with thrombocytopenia rather than intact teardrop-shaped cells.

exam.answer_en: True teardrop cells (dacrocytes) with randomly oriented tails — suggests marrow fibrosis or infiltration such as primary myelofibrosis
pearls_zh: 考法：常問「怎麼知道不是推片假象？」→ 尾端方向隨機；若全部朝同一方向則為製片假象。
下一步：看有無 leukoerythroblastosis、脾腫大，安排骨髓切片（含網狀纖維染色）與 JAK2/CALR/MPL 檢測。
脾切除後淚滴細胞常減少，顯示脾臟參與其形成。
其他病因：骨髓轉移癌、肉芽腫浸潤、thalassemia、megaloblastic anemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MAHA 的碎片紅血球；schistocyte 為盔形、三角形碎片並伴血小板低下，淚滴細胞則是完整細胞單端拉尖。

quiz.q: 如何從這張血片判斷淚滴細胞是真的而非推片假象？
quiz.a: 尾端指向隨機方向（假象則全部朝同一方向）

60896.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下一個雙核紅血球前驅細胞，兩個核大小不等、中間仍以細橋相連（不等分核出芽），核內高電子密度的異染色質呈粗大分支狀並佈滿許多小透亮孔洞，形成「瑞士起司」外觀，為 CDA type I 的特徵超微結構。
features: Transmission electron micrograph of an erythroid precursor with two unequal nuclear lobes joined by a narrow bridge
Electron-dense heterochromatin forming coarse, anastomosing bands and clumps
Numerous small electron-lucent vacuoles within the heterochromatin (Swiss cheese pattern)
Nuclear envelope largely intact; homogeneous electron-dense hemoglobinized cytoplasm
Adjacent red cells at edges of the field
60896.describe_en: Transmission electron microscopy of a bone marrow erythroid precursor shows a binucleated or bilobed cell with nuclear portions of unequal size connected by a narrow chromatin bridge. The heterochromatin is abnormally condensed into coarse, branching electron-dense masses riddled with small electron-lucent holes, producing a spongy Swiss cheese appearance. The cytoplasm is moderately electron dense, consistent with hemoglobinization. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type I.

ddx.vs: CDA II shows peripheral double membranes of endoplasmic reticulum parallel to the cell membrane on EM rather than spongy heterochromatin, with binucleated late normoblasts and a positive acidified serum test.
Megaloblastic precursors show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony but not the Swiss cheese heterochromatin or internuclear bridges.
MDS shows nuclear budding and ring sideroblasts in adults with clonal cytogenetic or mutational abnormalities, not the congenital CDAN1/CDIN1-related heterochromatin defect.

60832.recognize_zh: 六顆中型淋巴細胞皆有圓形核、清楚的單一中央核仁與較細緻的染色質，周圍淡藍灰色胞質帶有細毛狀突起（circumferential villi），合併淋巴球增多，提示 hairy cell leukemia variant（HCL-v，現稱 splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly oval central nuclei with moderately condensed, reticular chromatin
Single distinct nucleolus in most cells (prolymphocyte-like)
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hairy/villous projections
Background red cells unremarkable; cells shown individually in a six-panel montage
60832.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear montage shows medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round central nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a single conspicuous nucleolus. The cytoplasm is moderate, pale gray-blue and bears fine circumferential villous projections. Red cells in the background are unremarkable. Combined with a lymphocytosis, findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli); flow cytometry (CD11c+, CD103+/-, CD25-, CD123-), annexin A1 negativity and absence of BRAF V600E would support this over classic hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL cells have oval/bean-shaped nuclei with homogeneous chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli, present with monocytopenia and leukopenia, and are CD25+/CD123+/annexin A1+/BRAF V600E-mutated.
SMZL villous lymphocytes are smaller with clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and short polar villi, and are usually CD103-negative/CD11c-weak.
Prolymphocytes have prominent nucleoli but smooth cytoplasmic borders without villous projections.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villi with small nucleoli or none and are typically CD103-negative with less nucleolar prominence.

captions: A: villous lymphoid cell with central nucleolus
B: round nucleus with distinct nucleolus and fine villi
C: circumferential cytoplasmic projections
D: lymphoid cell with nucleolus and polar villi
E: villous cell with prominent nucleolus
F: lymphoid cell with eccentric nucleolus and hairy cytoplasm

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli) — villous lymphoid cells with a single conspicuous central nucleolus
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有細毛突起且核仁明顯的淋巴細胞，問「和典型 HCL 差在哪？」→ 核仁明顯、白血球增多且無單核球低下，提示 HCL-variant。
命名：WHO 5th 已取消 HCL-v 名稱，併入 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli；ICC 2022 仍保留 HCL variant。
表型與分子：CD11c+、CD103 常陽性，但 CD25−、CD123 陰性或弱、annexin A1−、TRAP 通常陰性；無 BRAF V600E，部分病例有 MAP2K1 突變。
治療意義：對 cladribine 單藥反應差於典型 HCL，常合併 rituximab；BRAF 抑制劑不適用。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為典型 hairy cell leukemia：典型 HCL 核卵圓或腎形、無明顯核仁，伴單核球低下，並 CD25+、annexin A1+、BRAF V600E；本圖細胞有清楚中央核仁。

quiz.q: 圖中帶絨毛且核仁明顯的淋巴細胞，若 CD25 陰性、annexin A1 陰性、BRAF V600E 陰性，診斷為何？
quiz.a: Hairy cell leukemia variant（WHO 5th：splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）

60768.recognize_zh: 在瀰漫的小型單形淋巴球（核圓、染色質稍粗、細胞質少至淡染）之間，散在幾顆核呈葡萄串狀重疊的多核巨細胞（Warthin-Finkeldey giant cells），伴隨明顯的玻璃樣化小血管。
features: Diffuse sheet of small to slightly medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and mildly clumped chromatin
Some cells with modest pale cytoplasm, suggestive of monocytoid/marginal zone B-cell differentiation
Several scattered multinucleated giant cells with overlapping, grape-like clusters of dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm (Warthin-Finkeldey-type)
Prominent small vessels with hyalinized, eosinophilic walls traversing the infiltrate
No follicular architecture, sclerosis bands or Reed-Sternberg cells identified in this field
60768.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows effacement by a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant to moderate pale cytoplasm, traversed by hyalinized small vessels. Scattered multinucleated giant cells with clustered, overlapping nuclei of Warthin-Finkeldey type are present within the infiltrate. Warthin-Finkeldey cells are a non-specific finding and do not by themselves indicate measles or a reactive process. In conjunction with a CD5-/CD10- B-cell phenotype and clonal IGH rearrangement, findings are consistent with nodal marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Warthin-Finkeldey cells occur in a reactive node with preserved florid follicular hyperplasia and no clonal, architecture-effacing B-cell population.
Polykaryocytes appear in a reactive background with eosinophils, plasma cells and preserved follicles, not a diffuse monotonous clonal infiltrate.
Multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells have large eosinophilic macronucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ in a mixed inflammatory background, unlike these dark-nucleated polykaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocytic lymphoma / mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Small-cell B-cell lymphomas with similar cytology are CD5 positive (with cyclin D1 in MCL), whereas this infiltrate is CD5 and CD10 negative.

60576.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現大量形態多樣的反應性淋巴球：大型、細胞質深藍、核偏位像漿細胞樣或免疫母細胞樣，另有細胞質豐富、邊緣貼附紅血球的 Downey 型淋巴球；這種異質性（非單一族群）是 EBV 反應性淋巴球增多而非淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Increased large lymphoid cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and relatively open chromatin (immunoblastic/plasmacytoid forms)
Heterogeneous spectrum of lymphocyte size and nuclear configuration rather than a monotonous population
Reactive lymphocytes with pale cytoplasm and a basophilic rim scalloping around adjacent red cells (panel B)
Red cells with slit-like central pallor (stomatocytes) and scattered target cells; platelets present
Inset: red cell containing a small round dark inclusion (Howell-Jolly body-like)
60576.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of a heterogeneous population of reactive lymphocytes, including large immunoblastic and plasmacytoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and cells with abundant cytoplasm showing basophilic rims that indent around neighboring erythrocytes. Red cells show numerous stomatocytes and occasional target cells, and the inset shows a red cell with a small dense inclusion resembling a Howell-Jolly body. Although some cells appear blastic, the morphologic spectrum favors a reactive process, and findings are consistent with Epstein-Barr virus-associated reactive lymphocytosis; flow cytometry showing polyclonal B cells and CD8+ T-cell expansion with positive EBV serology supports this.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of lymphoma (e.g. DLBCL, Burkitt)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are monotonous with light-chain restriction or clonal TCR, whereas EBV lymphocytosis shows a spectrum of forms and polyclonality.
Blasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli and scant cytoplasm and express CD34/TdT, lacking the abundant cytoplasm and red cell hugging of reactive cells.

ddx.dx: Cytomegalovirus or other viral mononucleosis-like illness
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable; heterophile antibody and EBV-specific serology or PCR discriminate.
Plasma cells show clock-face chromatin, perinuclear hof and CD138 positivity with light-chain restriction.

exam.answer_en: EBV-associated reactive lymphocytosis — heterogeneous spectrum of immunoblastic/plasmacytoid and Downey-type lymphocytes hugging red cells, not a monotonous clone
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指一顆看似 blast 的大型深藍胞質淋巴球問「是否為淋巴瘤」；答題關鍵是整體「形態光譜/異質性」，並指出邊緣深藍、包夾紅血球的 Downey cell。
Flow 讀法：反應性增生以 CD8+ T 細胞為主（常 HLA-DR+ 活化），B 細胞 kappa/lambda 多株；若出現輕鏈限制或 T 細胞異常抗原喪失才懷疑腫瘤。
EBV 檢查：heterophile antibody（Monospot，幼兒可偽陰性）、VCA IgM/IgG、EBNA；持續不退或伴全身症狀需查 EBV DNA 定量並考慮 chronic active EBV 或 EBV-HLH。
臨床意義：淋巴結與脾腫大、非典型淋巴球增加可被誤認為淋巴瘤而進行不必要的切片或治療；急性 IM 病人應避免劇烈接觸運動以防脾破裂。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 leukemic lymphoma 或 acute leukemia：腫瘤細胞呈單一形態、有輕鏈限制或 CD34/TdT 表現；EBV 反應性淋巴球大小與核型多樣、胞質豐富並貼附紅血球，flow 為多株。

quiz.q: 周邊血這群形態多樣的大型淋巴球，flow cytometry 上主要會是哪一種淋巴球亞群增加？
quiz.a: 活化的 CD8+ T 細胞（B 細胞為多株）。

60640.recognize_zh: 抹片中為中至大型、核質比高、染色質細緻且細胞質稀少淡藍的芽細胞；流式圖中綠色芽細胞為 cCD3+、CD7+、CD5+、CD34+ 且 CD13 陰性，支持 T 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin (staining appears magenta, possibly processing-related)
Scant rim of pale blue, agranular cytoplasm, some cells with small cytoplasmic blebs
Round to slightly irregular nuclei; nucleoli not well seen at this resolution
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules evident
Flow cytometry (green = blasts, red = lymphocytes): blasts cytoplasmic CD3+, CD5+, CD7+, CD34+ and CD13 negative
60640.describe_en: Peripheral blood/bone marrow smears show a population of medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm, without Auer rods. The smear coloration is unusual, which limits chromatin and nucleolar detail. Flow cytometry shows the blast population (green) expressing cytoplasmic CD3, CD5, CD7 and CD34, and lacking CD13, compared with residual normal lymphocytes (red). Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia; in the context of this patient, this represents one of sequentially developed acute leukemias of different lineage.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, but B-ALL expresses CD19, CD79a and CD10 and lacks cytoplasmic CD3.
AML-M0 blasts express CD13/CD33/CD117 and lack cytoplasmic CD3, whereas these blasts are CD13 negative and cCD3 positive.
ETP-ALL is CD1a and CD8 negative, CD5 dim/negative and expresses stem cell or myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, CD13, CD33), unlike this CD5-positive, CD13-negative phenotype.
MPAL T/myeloid requires MPO or monocytic differentiation in addition to cCD3, which is not shown here.

60704.recognize_zh: 頸部影像見增大的淋巴結（箭頭）與上下頜骨髓腔擴張（箭頭頭），切下的結節呈暗紅色；抹片與切片中可見巨核細胞與大量紅系前驅細胞，表示淋巴結被髓外造血（extramedullary hematopoiesis）取代，符合重型地中海貧血。
features: Axial CT (A): enlarged enhancing right cervical nodal mass (arrow) and expanded mandibular/maxillary marrow spaces with cortical thinning (arrowheads)
Coronal MRI (B): well-circumscribed heterogeneous hyperintense cervical nodal lesion (arrow)
Gross (D): dark red-brown, blood-colored nodular tissue about 1.5–3 cm
Imprint/aspirate (C): trilineage hematopoietic cells dominated by erythroid precursors with a megakaryocyte
H&E (E, F): lymph node with a capsule-bordered hematopoietic infiltrate containing sheets of normoblasts, granulocytic precursors and megakaryocytes
60704.describe_en: Cross-sectional imaging demonstrates an enlarged cervical lymph node lesion together with expansion of the facial bone marrow spaces. The excised nodules are dark red grossly. Touch/aspirate preparations and histologic sections show replacement of nodal parenchyma by trilineage hematopoiesis with erythroid predominance, scattered granulocytic precursors and megakaryocytes, without atypical blasts or a neoplastic infiltrate. Findings are consistent with nodal extramedullary hematopoiesis in the setting of β-thalassemia with marrow expansion of the facial bones.

ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma consists of sheets of immature blasts (CD34/CD117/MPO+) effacing the node rather than orderly maturing trilineage hematopoiesis.
EMH in primary myelofibrosis features atypical clustered megakaryocytes and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, without thalassemic red cell indices.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma or metastatic tumor in a cervical node
ddx.vs: A neoplasm shows a monotonous atypical infiltrate or cohesive tumor cells, not erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes.
Vascular lesions show blood-filled vascular channels grossly red but lack hematopoietic precursors histologically.

captions: Axial CT: cervical nodal mass (arrow) and expanded facial bone marrow (arrowheads)
Coronal MRI: hyperintense cervical nodal lesion (arrow)
Imprint: erythroid-predominant hematopoiesis with a megakaryocyte
Gross: dark red excised nodules
H&E low power: node replaced by hematopoietic tissue
H&E high power: megakaryocyte among erythroid and granulocytic precursors

60512.recognize_zh: 這顆大細胞核大而圓、染色質較細並可見數個核仁，細胞質呈深藍色（強嗜鹼性）且靠近核處有淡染區，外觀像免疫母細胞（immunoblast-like）的反應性淋巴球，需與原始細胞區分。
features: Large cell, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with round nucleus
Relatively fine to reticulated chromatin with two or more visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone on one side
Smooth round cell outline; no granules, vacuoles or Auer rods
60512.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, high N:C ratio, reticulated chromatin and several visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with a paler perinuclear zone and contains no granules or Auer rods. In isolation this cell resembles a blast; however, in the context of a heterogeneous lymphocytosis with a spectrum of reactive forms, it is consistent with an immunoblast-like reactive lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have very fine homogeneous chromatin, less intensely basophilic cytoplasm, may show Auer rods or granules, and are MPO positive, whereas immunoblasts show deep blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone amid other reactive lymphocytes.
Lymphoblasts are usually smaller with scant, less basophilic cytoplasm and inconspicuous nucleoli, and are TdT/CD34 positive.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a distinct Golgi hof and express CD138/MUM1 rather than being part of a mixed reactive population.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in blood (e.g. Burkitt or DLBCL)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells form a monotonous population, and Burkitt cells show deep blue cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles, unlike isolated reactive immunoblasts.

exam.answer_en: Reactive lymphocyte, immunoblast-like (Downey type III) — large cell with nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing
pearls_zh: 考法：這張是「看起來像芽細胞」的陷阱題，考官會問如何判斷不是急性白血病：看整張抹片是否有反應性淋巴球的連續光譜。
免疫母細胞樣反應性淋巴球對應 Downey III 型，常見於 EBV IM、CMV 與藥物反應；細胞質深藍、核周淡染（高基氏體區）反映抗體/蛋白合成活化。
若同類細胞單一且大量，需做 flow（CD34、TdT、CD19、CD3、MPO）排除急性白血病或大細胞淋巴瘤進入血液。
反應性增生的 flow 為多株性（kappa/lambda 混合、T 細胞無抗原缺失），可與 B 細胞淋巴瘤區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 myeloblast 或 lymphoblast；本細胞細胞質深嗜鹼性伴核周淡區、無 Auer rod，且背景有反應性淋巴球光譜，孤立判讀易誤診白血病。

quiz.q: 此顆有核仁、細胞質深藍的大細胞出現在 IM 病人的血液中，應如何稱呼？與 blast 區分的關鍵是什麼？
quiz.a: Immunoblast-like reactive lymphocyte（Downey III）；看形態光譜與 flow（非單一克隆、CD34/TdT 陰性）

60448.recognize_zh: 切片中散布數顆中等大小的巨核細胞，其核小而圓、不分葉或僅輕度分葉（hypolobated），與豐富粉紅色細胞質不成比例，左中方另有一顆核分開的巨核細胞；這些不典型巨核細胞在 GATA2 缺乏合併第 7 號染色體單體的背景下代表發育不良。
features: Several megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm (monolobated forms)
A megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes (left center) and one with hyperchromatic clumped nucleus (lower right)
Megakaryocytes smaller than normal and scattered singly
Erythroid precursors prominent, with round dense nuclei, admixed with granulocytic precursors
Interspersed adipocytes and hemosiderin granules in this cellular focus
60448.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a cellular focus with adipocytes in which erythroid precursors are prominent and granulocytic precursors are present. Megakaryocytes are atypical, including small to medium-sized forms with round non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei, a form with separated nuclei, and one with a hyperchromatic nucleus. Blasts are not increased and scattered hemosiderin granules are present. Although this field is focally cellular, the overall marrow is hypocellular for age; megakaryocytic atypia together with monosomy 7 and germline GATA2 mutation is consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, GATA2 deficiency-related.

ddx.vs: 5q- MDS also shows monolobated megakaryocytes, but occurs in adults with macrocytic anemia, thrombocytosis and isolated del(5q), not a pediatric patient with monosomy 7.
Aplastic anemia has markedly reduced megakaryocytes without dysplasia, whereas this marrow shows retained, atypical megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (e.g., infection such as MAC)
ddx.vs: Reactive states rarely produce consistent hypolobated and separated-nuclei forms and lack clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

60384.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中，大量小型 B 細胞呈強膜狀陽性，形成緻密的背景；其間穿插 CD20 陰性的區域，內含較大的未染色細胞，提示小淋巴球性淋巴瘤（SLL）的背景中混有 CD20 陰性的大型細胞（Hodgkin 型 Richter 轉化時應以 CD30/CD15 確認）。
features: Sheets of small, uniform lymphocytes with strong, crisp membranous CD20 staining
Diffuse architecture without follicular pattern in the positive areas
Interspersed irregular CD20-negative zones containing unstained small cells and occasional larger cells
Large cells within negative zones lack CD20 membrane staining
Delicate CD20-positive cells outlining the negative areas in a reticular pattern
60384.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for CD20 on a lymph node shows a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphocytes with strong membranous CD20 expression. Irregular CD20-negative areas are interspersed, containing unstained small lymphocytes and scattered larger cells that do not express CD20. In the setting of CLL/SLL, the CD20-negative large cells should be characterized with CD30, CD15, PAX5 and EBER to confirm Hodgkin-type Richter transformation. Findings are consistent with an SLL background with CD20-negative large cells, compatible with the reported Hodgkin-type Richter transformation.

ddx.vs: Proliferation-center prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts are CD20-positive B cells, whereas Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD20-negative or weak and CD30+/CD15+.

ddx.dx: CLL/SLL with scattered HRS-like cells (Hodgkin-like cells in a CLL background)
ddx.vs: HRS-like cells scattered within CLL without a distinct polymorphous reactive T-cell/histiocyte-rich background are not classified as classic Hodgkin lymphoma; the architecture of the negative zones is the discriminator.
DLBCL-type Richter forms confluent sheets of large CD20-positive B cells rather than isolated CD20-negative large cells.

60192.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度明顯偏高（約80%），在密集的造血細胞中可見數顆偏小的巨核細胞，細胞核呈少數幾個分開的小圓核或單一小核，而不是正常的多葉相連核；背景散在棕色含鐵血黃素，符合MDS伴過多芽細胞的巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Hypercellular marrow (approximately 80%) with scattered residual adipocytes
Dysplastic megakaryocytes with small, round, separated nuclear lobes or single small nuclei in moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Dense population of immature myeloid cells with oval nuclei and open chromatin admixed with erythroid precursors
Scattered granular golden-brown hemosiderin pigment in the interstitium
No fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates evident
60192.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow for age, with approximately 80% cellularity. There are dysplastic megakaryocytes, including forms with small, widely separated round nuclear lobes and small forms with single compact nuclei. The background consists of a dense mixed population of immature myeloid cells and erythroid precursors, with scattered hemosiderin deposits. Blast quantitation requires CD34 immunohistochemistry and an aspirate differential. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts in conjunction with the reported 10–19% marrow blasts.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei forming clusters, unlike the small separated-lobe forms here.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: AML-MR requires ≥20% blasts, often seen as sheets of CD34-positive cells on biopsy.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (HIV, drugs, B12 deficiency)
ddx.vs: Reactive states can cause separated lobes but show megaloblastic change or a clinical cause and lack clonal cytogenetic abnormalities and excess blasts.
CMML shows similar dysplasia but requires persistent peripheral monocytosis with increased CD14/CD163-positive marrow monocytes.

60128.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成片小至中型圓形腫瘤細胞彼此緊貼、核相互擠壓（molding），核質比高、染色質細顆粒狀，背景可見淡紫色纖維狀的 neuropil 帶狀物，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Sheets and cohesive clusters of small-to-medium round tumor cells
High N:C ratio with scant pale-blue cytoplasm and nuclear molding
Round nuclei with finely granular, salt-and-pepper chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Pale lilac fibrillary streaks of neuropil between cell groups
Admixed red cells and few normal hematopoietic cells
60128.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets and cohesive clusters of small to medium-sized round tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, scant cytoplasm, finely granular chromatin and nuclear molding. Pale lilac fibrillary neuropil is present between the cell groups. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma, which can be confirmed with immunostains such as PHOX2B, synaptophysin or chromogranin.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are non-cohesive, lack molding and neuropil, and are CD45, TdT and CD19 or CD3 positive.
Ewing cells often show cytoplasmic vacuoles and PAS-positive glycogen without neuropil, expressing CD99 and NKX2.2.
Rhabdomyosarcoma may have more cytoplasm and multinucleate forms, and is desmin/myogenin positive.

ddx.dx: Medulloblastoma or small cell carcinoma metastasis
ddx.vs: Clinical age and primary site plus markers (e.g., TTF-1, keratin) help separate these from PHOX2B-positive neuroblastoma.

29664.recognize_zh: 胸部 CT 顯示前縱膈腔腫塊（箭頭，A）；細胞學抹片中在小淋巴球背景裡散布大型、雙核或多葉核、具明顯大核仁的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞（B、C），D 圖為染色結果，符合古典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤；結節硬化亞型需組織切片確認。
features: Panel A: contrast CT of the chest with an anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass (arrow)
Panels B-C: large binucleate and multilobated cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm and prominent inclusion-like nucleoli (Reed-Sternberg cells)
Mirror-image nuclear configuration in the high-power inset (C)
Background of numerous small lymphocytes with scattered granulocytes
Panel D: single large cell with brown chromogenic staining of uncertain antigen at this resolution
29664.describe_en: Composite figure. Chest CT (A) demonstrates an anterior mediastinal mass. The cytologic preparation (B, C; Romanowsky-type stain) shows scattered large binucleate and multilobated cells with abundant cytoplasm and prominent macronucleoli, including classic mirror-image Reed-Sternberg forms, in a background of abundant small lymphocytes. Panel D shows chromogenic staining of a large cell, but the antigen and pattern cannot be reliably assessed at this resolution. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma; the nodular sclerosis subtype requires histology showing collagen bands and lacunar cells, with CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: PMBL shows sheets of large cells with clear cytoplasm and strong CD20/CD79a with CD23 and MAL, rather than scattered RS cells in a lymphocyte-rich background.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe/kidney-shaped nuclei, grow cohesively and are CD30+ with T-cell antigens, often ALK+, and CD15/PAX5 negative.
Thymic tumors show cohesive keratin-positive epithelial cells, and the lymphocytes in thymoma are TdT-positive immature T cells.
Seminoma cells are large with clear cytoplasm in a tigroid background, and express OCT4, SALL4 and CD117 rather than CD30/CD15.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (anterior mediastinal mass) — binucleate mirror-image Reed–Sternberg cells with macronucleoli in a small lymphocyte background
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指雙核、各帶大型包涵體樣核仁的鏡像大細胞，問名稱（Reed-Sternberg cell）；再看 CT 前縱膈腫塊，問最可能亞型（年輕女性常為 nodular sclerosis）。
IHC：RS 細胞 CD30+、CD15+（多數）、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45 陰性、CD20 陰性或弱且不一致；EBV（EBER/LMP1）陽性率依亞型不同，NS 型相對較低。
NS 亞型確診需組織切片：纖維膠原帶分隔結節與 lacunar cells；細針抽吸細胞學只能提示 cHL，不能分亞型，建議做切除或 core biopsy。
治療連結：常見方案 ABVD，進展期可用 brentuximab vedotin（抗 CD30）合併 AVD 或 nivolumab-AVD；腫瘤常有 9p24.1 擴增造成 PD-L1 高表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma 混淆（同樣年輕女性前縱膈）：PMBL 為成片大細胞、CD20/CD79a 強陽性且 CD45 陽性；cHL 的 RS 細胞零星散在大量反應性背景中，CD45 與 CD20 陰性、CD30/CD15 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中雙核鏡像、帶巨大核仁的細胞稱為什麼？其典型免疫表型為何？
quiz.a: Reed-Sternberg cell；CD30+、CD15+、PAX5 弱陽、CD45−、CD20−。

26720.recognize_zh: 十個顆粒球的細胞核分別彎曲成像數字 0 到 9 的形狀（0 為中央有孔的環狀核），胞質有明顯顆粒；這是核形變異的趣味圖，環狀核（ring nucleus）可見於慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）等骨髓增生狀態，但光憑此圖無法診斷 CML。
features: Granulocytes with band-like and segmented nuclei contorted into shapes resembling numerals 0 through 9
Ring-shaped (doughnut) nucleus with central cytoplasmic hole (panel A)
Coarsely clumped nuclear chromatin appropriate for mature neutrophils
Abundant cytoplasm with prominent, coarse purple-brown granules
No blasts or other diagnostic cells shown in these cropped panels
26720.describe_en: Composite of cropped granulocytes in which band and segmented nuclei assume configurations resembling the numerals 0 through 9, including a ring-shaped nucleus with a central hole. The nuclear chromatin is mature and clumped, and the cytoplasm contains prominent coarse granules. These nuclear shapes are morphologic curiosities; ring nuclei can be seen in myeloproliferative neoplasms such as CML, myelodysplasia and after certain drugs. The cropped panels alone do not establish a diagnosis, which requires the full smear, CBC and BCR::ABL1 testing.

ddx.vs: In MDS, ring forms are accompanied by hypogranular cytoplasm and pseudo-Pelger-Huët nuclei rather than the well-granulated cytoplasm seen here.
Pelgeroid cells have bilobed spectacle or non-segmented round nuclei with very coarse chromatin, not elongated contorted bands.
Hypersegmentation shows six or more discrete lobes connected by fine filaments rather than a single continuous contorted nucleus.

16992.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞豐富，可見數顆大型巨核細胞（megakaryocytes），細胞質豐富、核較少分葉或呈緊密分葉，零散分布而非緊密成群，無明顯異型性，符合 ITP 中巨核細胞數量正常或增加的骨髓變化。
features: Cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, including many erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Several large megakaryocytes with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Megakaryocyte nuclei relatively compact with less lobulation, suggesting younger forms
Megakaryocytes dispersed, without tight clustering or bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei
Sinusoidal space with red cells at center; no fibrosis or abnormal infiltrate evident
16992.describe_en: Bone marrow section (Giemsa-type stain) shows a cellular marrow with active trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes appear increased in this field, with at least three large forms showing abundant cytoplasm and relatively compact, less lobulated nuclei, dispersed near a sinusoid without tight clustering or significant atypia. There is no fibrosis or abnormal infiltrate in this field. Findings are consistent with normal-to-increased megakaryopoiesis as seen in immune thrombocytopenia, supporting peripheral platelet destruction rather than a production defect.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are enlarged with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and loose clusters, and occur with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.
MDS shows dysplastic small hypolobated or separated-lobe micromegakaryocytes and dysplasia in other lineages.
Production defects show absent or markedly reduced megakaryocytes, unlike the preserved megakaryocytes here.
Marrow megakaryocytes are similarly preserved, so separation relies on the smear, coagulation studies and clinical findings.

15200.recognize_zh: 雙下肢廣泛暗紅至紫褐色斑塊，左小腿有一個突起、表面結痂出血的腫瘤性病灶（tumor），在斑塊背景上出現腫瘤即代表蕈狀肉芽腫進入腫瘤期（stage IIB）。
features: Large exophytic, crusted and hemorrhagic tumor on the posterior left calf
Background of widespread violaceous to red-brown patches and plaques on both legs
Scattered scaly and eroded areas with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
Tumor arises within pre-existing patch/plaque disease
Clinical photograph; no histology shown
15200.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the posterior lower legs shows extensive violaceous and red-brown patches and plaques with scaling and dyspigmentation on both limbs. A single large exophytic tumor with a crusted, hemorrhagic surface is present on the left calf. The presence of at least one tumor (≥1 cm) in the setting of patch/plaque disease corresponds to tumor-stage (stage IIB) mycosis fungoides, as stated in the legend. Biopsy of the tumor is warranted to assess for large-cell transformation and CD30 expression.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: C-ALCL presents as solitary or localized nodules/tumors without a preceding background of patches and plaques, and shows sheets of CD30+ large cells in >75% of the infiltrate.
Large-cell transformation is defined histologically (large cells >25% of the infiltrate) and cannot be diagnosed clinically; tumors often harbor it, so biopsy is required.

ddx.dx: Squamous cell carcinoma / ulcerated skin cancer
ddx.vs: An ulcerated keratinizing tumor may look similar, but biopsy shows atypical keratinocytes invading dermis rather than an atypical T-cell infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma (e.g., gamma-delta or CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic)
ddx.vs: These present with rapidly developing ulcerated tumors without a long patch/plaque prodrome and have distinct cytotoxic immunophenotypes.

exam.answer_en: Tumor-stage mycosis fungoides (stage IIB) — exophytic crusted tumor on the left calf arising on widespread patch/plaque disease
pearls_zh: 考法：臨床照片；考官指著左小腿突起結痂的病灶問「這個病灶讓分期變成幾期？」答：出現 ≥1 cm 腫瘤→T3，stage IIB。
腫瘤期病灶需切片評估 large-cell transformation（大細胞 >25% 浸潤細胞）與 CD30 表現；transformation 與較差預後相關。
治療：局部腫瘤對放射治療敏感；廣泛病灶可用 total skin electron beam therapy，系統性選項包括 bexarotene、interferon、mogamulizumab，CD30 陽性者可用 brentuximab vedotin。
有腫瘤期或更晚期疾病時應評估淋巴結與血液（Sézary cell/flow，B 分期），並考慮影像檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把單發腫瘤誤判為 primary cutaneous ALCL；C-ALCL 通常無先前長期 patch/plaque 病史，而本例腫瘤出現在廣泛斑塊背景上，屬 MF 腫瘤期。

quiz.q: 蕈狀肉芽腫病人在 patch/plaque 背景上出現左小腿腫瘤，T 分期與臨床分期為何？此腫瘤切片要特別評估什麼？
quiz.a: T3、stage IIB；large-cell transformation 與 CD30 表現

15072.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片在紅血球之間可見成對的小型藍紫色球菌（箭頭），中性球細胞質有空泡與毒性變化，旁邊的革蘭氏染色為成對的革蘭氏陽性雙球菌，符合猛爆性肺炎鏈球菌菌血症（常見於脾臟切除／功能性無脾）。
features: Small dark-blue extracellular cocci in pairs and short chains lying between red cells (arrow)
Neutrophil with cytoplasmic vacuolation and coarse (toxic) granules
Platelets are scarce in the field, supporting thrombocytopenia
Red cells largely normocytic without prominent schistocytes in this field
Right panel Gram stain: gram-positive diplococci among host cells and debris
15072.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small extracellular bacterial cocci, predominantly in pairs, scattered between the erythrocytes. A neutrophil displays cytoplasmic vacuolation and toxic granulation, and platelets are sparse in the field. The accompanying Gram stain shows gram-positive diplococci. Detection of organisms on a routine blood smear indicates a very high-grade bacteremia. Findings are consistent with fulminant pneumococcal (Streptococcus pneumoniae) bacteremia; asplenia or hyposplenism and disseminated intravascular coagulation should be evaluated.

ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular in size and lies on top of cells in variable focal planes, whereas true diplococci are uniform, paired, and confirmed by Gram stain and culture.

ddx.dx: Platelet fragments or Howell-Jolly bodies released from cells
ddx.vs: Platelet debris is pale with granular centers and Howell-Jolly bodies sit within red cells, unlike uniform paired extracellular cocci.
Meningococci are gram-negative kidney-shaped diplococci, distinguished from gram-positive lancet-shaped pneumococci by Gram stain and culture.
Capnocytophaga appears as long thin fusiform gram-negative rods, often intraneutrophilic, rather than cocci in pairs.

exam.answer_en: Fulminant pneumococcal bacteremia — extracellular diplococci between RBCs on routine smear, gram-positive diplococci on Gram stain
pearls_zh: 考法：指著紅血球之間的小藍紫色成對顆粒問是什麼；答「細菌（雙球菌）」並說明在常規抹片看得到菌代表極高菌量、預後極差。
病人背景：想到脾切除或功能性無脾（如鐮刀型貧血）引起的 overwhelming post-splenectomy infection；抹片上 Howell-Jolly bodies 是無脾的線索。
急症：常合併 DIC、血小板低下與 Waterhouse-Friderichsen 症候群；應立即抽血培養並經驗性給予廣效抗生素，不等培養結果。
預防：脾切除前（或術後）接種肺炎鏈球菌、腦膜炎雙球菌與 Hib 疫苗；無脾病人發燒應視為急症。
鑑別菌種：Neisseria meningitidis 為革蘭氏陰性雙球菌；狗咬傷後的 Capnocytophaga canimorsus 為革蘭氏陰性細長桿菌，常見於中性球內。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最容易被當成染劑沉澱或血小板碎片而忽略；細菌大小一致、成對排列且位於同一焦平面，Gram stain 可確認為革蘭氏陽性雙球菌。

quiz.q: 紅血球之間成對的小顆粒是什麼？這個病人最需要追問哪一項病史？
quiz.a: 肺炎鏈球菌（gram-positive diplococci）；脾切除或功能性無脾

12960.recognize_zh: 視野右側有一大團聚集在一起的血小板（platelet clump），而其他區域幾乎看不到散在的血小板；自動計數機把血小板團塊算成一顆或漏算，造成假性血小板低下（通常與 EDTA 有關）。
features: Large aggregate of numerous granular platelets forming a clump
Paucity of free single platelets elsewhere in the field
Segmented neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without schistocytes
No other leukocyte or red cell abnormalities in the field
12960.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large aggregate of platelets with few free-lying platelets elsewhere. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, and the neutrophil is morphologically unremarkable. Platelet clumping of this kind causes spurious lowering of the automated platelet count. Findings are consistent with pseudothrombocytopenia, most often EDTA-dependent; a repeat count from a citrate- or heparin-anticoagulated sample or a fingerstick smear is recommended to establish the true platelet count.

ddx.vs: ITP shows genuinely few platelets, often large, without clumps, and the low count persists in citrated samples.
Satellitism shows platelets rosetting around neutrophils rather than forming free-lying clumps.
Macrothrombocytopenias show single giant platelets (sometimes counted as red cells) rather than aggregates of normal-sized platelets.

ddx.dx: Clot formation from a traumatic draw
ddx.vs: Partial clotting shows platelet clumps with fibrin strands and a falsely low count in any anticoagulant, and is resolved by a clean redraw.

exam.answer_en: Pseudothrombocytopenia — large platelet clump with few free platelets, spuriously lowering the automated count (usually EDTA-dependent)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指右側那團聚集物問「這是什麼、血小板數可信嗎」；任何意外的血小板低下，在診斷 ITP 或輸血前都要先看抹片（特別是 feathered edge）。
機轉：EDTA 依賴性的 IgG/IgM 自體抗體，辨識在 EDTA 螯合鈣後暴露的 GPIIb/IIIa 抗原決定位，屬體外現象，病人無出血傾向。
處理：改用 citrate（需校正稀釋倍數）或 heparin 抗凝管重抽，或指尖血直接抹片估計；分析儀常出現 platelet clump flag。
其他造成假性血小板低下的原因：platelet satellitism、巨大血小板（被計為紅血球）、採血不良導致部分凝固；GPIIb/IIIa 抑制劑也可誘發 EDTA 依賴性聚集。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把血小板團塊誤當成單一巨大血小板或白血球碎片，進而誤診為 ITP 或遺傳性巨大血小板症；關鍵是團塊由許多正常大小的血小板組成，且其他區域散在血小板很少。

quiz.q: 無出血症狀但自動計數血小板極低，抹片見圖中團塊，最可能的診斷與下一步檢查為何？
quiz.a: EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia；改用 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重新計數

12640.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆大型原始細胞細胞質極深藍、邊緣可有空泡或偽足，核圓、染色質細緻並有核仁，外觀像原紅血球（proerythroblasts），與旁邊較成熟的紅血球母細胞並存；對應多發性骨髓瘤治療後演變的急性紅血球白血病（純紅血球白血病）。
features: Large blasts with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, occasionally with small vacuoles and irregular blebbed borders
Some blasts show a perinuclear clear zone
Intermediate erythroid precursors (basophilic/polychromatophilic normoblasts) with round nuclei and coarser chromatin
One mature cell with dense chromatin and granular grey cytoplasm; no Auer rods or plasma cells clearly identified
12640.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite) shows numerous large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli, and deeply basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm with blebbed borders, admixed with basophilic and polychromatophilic erythroid precursors. No Auer rods are identified and neoplastic plasma cells are not evident in the fields shown. The morphology favors proerythroblasts, and in the setting of pancytopenia and prior plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of acute erythroid leukemia (therapy-related); confirmation requires erythroid immunophenotyping (CD71, E-cadherin, glycophorin A, CD117), a differential showing ≥80% erythroid precursors with ≥30% proerythroblasts, and cytogenetic/TP53 analysis.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythropoiesis shows full maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes and reverses with B12/folate, unlike a blast-predominant arrest.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a hof and are CD138/CD38 positive with light-chain restriction rather than E-cadherin/CD71 positive.
Megakaryoblasts also have basophilic blebby cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and erythroid-marker negative.
Parvovirus produces isolated giant pronormoblasts with glassy nuclear inclusions and absent later erythroid forms, and is confirmed by B19 PCR or IHC.

3424.recognize_zh: 這是一張非對比頭部電腦斷層（CT）軸切面，雙側側腦室位置可見高密度（白色）出血，左側（影像右側）較大，周圍有低密度水腫；配合急性前骨髓性白血病（APL）病史，代表凝血病變造成的中樞神經出血。
features: Axial non-contrast head CT image
Large hyperdense (acute blood) collections centered in the region of both lateral ventricles/periventricular parenchyma, larger on the patient's left (image right)
Surrounding hypodense rim consistent with edema
Mild mass effect with effacement of adjacent sulci; midline structures not markedly displaced
No morphologic (cellular) information in this image
3424.describe_en: This is an axial non-contrast head CT image rather than a morphologic specimen. It shows bilateral hyperdense acute hemorrhage in the region of the lateral ventricles and adjacent periventricular parenchyma, larger on the patient's left, with surrounding hypodense edema and mild mass effect. In a patient with acute promyelocytic leukemia, such intracranial hemorrhage reflects APL-associated coagulopathy (DIC with hyperfibrinolysis), the leading cause of early death. The image underscores the need to start ATRA immediately on morphologic suspicion and aggressively replace platelets and fibrinogen.

ddx.vs: Hypertensive bleeds are typically single and centered in the basal ganglia, thalamus, pons or cerebellum in older patients without coagulopathy.
Leukostasis-related bleeds occur with very high blast counts and are often multifocal, whereas APL usually presents with low WBC and laboratory evidence of DIC.

ddx.dx: Hemorrhagic transformation of infarct or venous sinus thrombosis
ddx.vs: These follow vascular territories or show sinus thrombus on CT venography, rather than coagulopathy-driven bleeding.

3744.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中主要是脂肪空泡、梭形/卵圓形基質細胞與含空泡的組織球，幾乎看不到成熟中的紅血球系或顆粒球系前驅細胞，呈現移植後造血重建失敗（graft failure）時的低細胞性骨髓。
features: Marrow particle composed predominantly of fat vacuoles of varying size
Numerous stromal cells and histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei and pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Scattered dark granular pigment and cellular debris in the background
Near absence of maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors
No megakaryocytes or blasts identified in this field
3744.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed largely of adipocytes, stromal cells and vacuolated histiocytes with scattered pigment-laden debris. Maturing erythroid and myeloid precursors are virtually absent, and no megakaryocytes or blasts are seen in this field. The findings indicate a markedly hypocellular, stroma-rich marrow; in a post-transplant setting this is consistent with graft failure, pending chimerism studies and biopsy cellularity assessment.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical fatty, stroma-rich particles; distinction rests on clinical history of transplantation and donor chimerism analysis.
Also hypocellular with histiocytes and debris, but it is time-limited after cytotoxic therapy and followed by regenerating islands on serial samples.
Relapse shows blasts on aspirate or biopsy and recipient-derived chimerism, whereas this field contains no blasts.
A dilute sample lacks particles and is mostly peripheral blood, whereas this particle itself is fatty and stromal, confirming true hypocellularity.

1376.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆巨大血小板，中心為深紫色顆粒區（granulomere）、周圍淡藍色透明區（hyalomere）並有不規則突起，大小接近小淋巴球；另一顆血小板極小，整體血小板稀少，符合周邊破壞型血小板低下（如 HIV 相關）。
features: Single giant platelet with a dense purple central granulomere and a pale blue peripheral hyalomere
Irregular, spiky cytoplasmic projections of the platelet margin
Only one other small platelet in the field, indicating thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic with no schistocytes
No white cells in this field
1376.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets, with a single giant platelet displaying a dense purple granular center, pale blue hyalomere and irregular projections, and one small platelet elsewhere in the field. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes or spherocytes. The presence of large platelets in thrombocytopenia suggests increased marrow platelet production in response to peripheral destruction, as seen in HIV-associated immune thrombocytopenia; the finding is nonspecific and requires clinical and serologic correlation.

ddx.vs: Same blood smear appearance; distinguished by the absence of HIV or other secondary causes.
Most platelets are uniformly large, often with a family history and neutrophil inclusions in MYH9-related disease.
Contains a nucleus or nuclear fragment, unlike an anucleate giant platelet.

1312.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一群母細胞，胞質深藍且邊緣有泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），部分核呈不規則或凹陷，旁邊還可見有核紅血球；這種帶胞質突起的母細胞是巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）的典型線索，配合唐氏症背景即 ML-DS。
features: Cluster of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and moderately condensed to fine chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections
Some blasts with indented or folded nuclei; cytoplasm agranular with pale vacuolated zones
Circulating nucleated red cell (orthochromatic normoblast) at lower left
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
1312.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of circulating blasts. The blasts are medium to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs and irregular projections. A nucleated red blood cell is present, and red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. The blast morphology suggests megakaryoblastic differentiation; in a patient with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (acute megakaryoblastic type), to be confirmed by flow cytometry for CD41/CD61 and GATA1 mutation studies.

ddx.vs: TAM blasts are morphologically identical megakaryoblasts, so the distinction is clinical: TAM presents in the neonatal period (usually <3 months) and regresses spontaneously, whereas ML-DS arises later, typically before age 5.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebbing and are CD19 or cCD3 positive, whereas megakaryoblasts express CD41/CD61.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, while megakaryoblasts are NSE-negative and platelet glycoprotein positive.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (megakaryoblastic) — circulating blasts with deeply basophilic, blebbed cytoplasm and a nucleated red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著胞質邊緣有泡狀突起的母細胞問細胞系；答 megakaryoblast，並追問表型：CD41、CD61、CD42b 陽性，MPO 陰性，常 CD34/CD117 陽性。
ML-DS 的分子特徵是 GATA1 exon 2 突變產生短型 GATA1s，加上 trisomy 21 背景；後續疾病進展常伴 cohesin、CTCF 或 JAK/STAT 路徑等附加突變。
與 TAM 的區分是臨床時間點：TAM 出現在新生兒期、多數自行消退；ML-DS 通常發生在 4–5 歲以前，部分之前有 TAM 病史。
ML-DS 對 cytarabine 特別敏感，預後比非唐氏症的 AMKL 好，可採用降低強度的化療方案。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 lymphoblast（ALL）：megakaryoblast 胞質深藍有 blebs、flow 為 CD41/CD61+；唐氏症兒童亦好發 ALL，必須以 flow 確認 lineage。

quiz.q: 唐氏症病童出現圖中帶胞質突起的母細胞，與此疾病相關的突變基因是什麼？
quiz.a: GATA1（exon 2 突變，產生 GATA1s）

1184.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一個幾乎沒有細胞質、深染的橢圓形巨核細胞裸核（naked megakaryocyte nucleus），邊緣黏著血小板碎片，背景紅血球大小形狀不一並有淚滴細胞，是骨髓纖維化的典型周邊血液表現。
features: Circulating bare (naked) megakaryocyte nucleus: dense, oval, coarsely clumped chromatin with little or no cytoplasm and attached platelet fragments
Anisopoikilocytosis with scattered teardrop cells and elliptocytes
Band/segmented neutrophil with coarse granulation
Platelets of variable size, including large forms
No blasts or nucleated red cells in this field
1184.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes. A circulating naked megakaryocyte nucleus is present, appearing as a dense, oval nucleus with coarse chromatin, virtually no cytoplasm and small adherent platelet fragments. A band neutrophil and platelets of variable size, including large forms, are also seen. Circulating megakaryocyte nuclei together with dacrocytes reflect extramedullary hematopoiesis and marrow fibrosis. Findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and marrow context.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a round nucleus with a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and no adherent platelet material, whereas a bare megakaryocyte nucleus is denser, often elongated or lobulated, with attached platelet fragments.
Micromegakaryocytes retain a rim of granular cytoplasm; distinction is mainly by clinical context and accompanying findings such as basophilia or dysplasia.
Myelophthisis also causes teardrops and circulating megakaryocyte nuclei; marrow biopsy and driver mutation testing distinguish it.
Smudge cells show a spread-out, pale, homogeneous chromatin smear rather than a compact dense nucleus with attached platelets.

exam.answer_en: Myelofibrosis, peripheral blood — circulating bare (naked) megakaryocyte nucleus with attached platelet fragments, teardrop cells and elliptocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著中央深染、幾乎無胞質的橢圓核問「這是淋巴球嗎？」；答 naked megakaryocyte nucleus，邊緣黏著血小板碎片是辨識關鍵。
周邊血出現巨核細胞裸核或 micromegakaryocyte 代表骨髓外造血或骨髓構造破壞，常見於 PMF 與 post-PV/ET myelofibrosis，也可見於 CML。
配套判讀：淚滴細胞、NRBC、未成熟顆粒球（leukoerythroblastosis）與大型血小板共同出現時，應安排骨髓切片（常 dry tap）與 JAK2/CALR/MPL 檢測。
Myelophthisis（轉移癌、肉芽腫、感染）也可有相同周邊血表現，骨髓切片是區分 MPN 纖維化與浸潤性病灶的關鍵。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為小淋巴球：小淋巴球核圓、染色質塊狀且有一圈藍色胞質；巨核細胞裸核通常較大、形狀不規則、染色質更緻密，並黏附血小板碎片而無完整胞質。

quiz.q: 圖中央深染、無胞質並黏著血小板碎片的構造是什麼？
quiz.a: Naked (bare) megakaryocyte nucleus

1120.recognize_zh: 周邊血中數顆小到中型淋巴球，胞質少量但深嗜鹼性，核圓或略不規則，箭頭所指的細胞核緻密且胞質藍色邊緣明顯，是 T-PLL 的小細胞型態。
features: Increased small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm (arrow)
One cell with irregular, elongated nuclear outline and cytoplasmic protrusion
Normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
1120.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant to moderate and intensely basophilic without granules (arrow), and one cell shows an irregular nuclear outline with a cytoplasmic protrusion. No smudge cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, including its small-cell variant; flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have coarse block-like chromatin, pale scant cytoplasm and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and less basophilic cytoplasm, typically CD7 and CD26 negative.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a CD8+/CD57+ phenotype.

1056.recognize_zh: 周邊血中同時看到嗜鹼性球（深色粗顆粒蓋住核）、含粗顆粒且核未分葉的未成熟顆粒球，以及分葉與帶狀嗜中性球，這種「各階段顆粒球加上嗜鹼性球」的組合是 CML 的周邊血表現。
features: Two basophils with dense dark granules obscuring the nucleus (top and left-center)
Two large immature granulocytes (myelocyte/metamyelocyte) with indented nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm at right
Segmented and band neutrophils present
Red cells with target-like and stomatocyte-like forms and occasional crenated cells, partly drying artifact
Platelets present in small clumps
1056.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a left-shifted granulocytic population including immature granulocytes (myelocytes/metamyelocytes) with abundant granular cytoplasm, band and segmented neutrophils, and two basophils. No blasts are seen in this field. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with target-like and stomatocyte-like forms, some attributable to drying artifact, and platelets are present in small clumps. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with basophilia; in the clinical context of relapse, correlation with blast and basophil percentages is needed to stage the disease.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Dohle bodies with no basophilia and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis without significant basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL is dominated by mature segmented neutrophils with immature granulocytes <10%, no basophilia, and CSF3R mutation.

4192.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞，偏心核、細胞質呈藍紫色且帶顆粒感，細胞質內有數個淡藍灰色、圓形、邊界清楚的球狀包涵體，不壓在核上，即 Russell bodies。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Three round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray globules in the cytoplasm (Russell bodies), separate from the nucleus
Adjacent plasmacytoid cell with oval nucleus and pale perinuclear cytoplasm
Background band neutrophils, myelocytes and small lymphocytes/erythroid precursors
4192.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing several round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray cytoplasmic globules consistent with Russell bodies. An adjacent plasmacytoid cell and background maturing granulocytes are present. Russell bodies represent distended rough endoplasmic reticulum filled with immunoglobulin; they can be seen in reactive and neoplastic plasma cells, so clonality should be assessed by light-chain studies.

ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies overlie or indent the nucleus as pseudo-intranuclear inclusions, whereas these globules are purely cytoplasmic.
A Mott cell is packed with numerous Russell bodies filling the cytoplasm, rather than the few globules seen here.
Vacuoles are optically empty, whereas Russell bodies are homogeneous, glassy and faintly stained.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell with Russell bodies — round homogeneous cytoplasmic immunoglobulin globules separate from the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭漿細胞細胞質內的淡藍灰圓球，問名稱、位置與成分。答 Russell bodies：Ig 堆積於擴張的 rough endoplasmic reticulum，位於細胞質、PAS 陽性。
細胞質塞滿大量 Russell bodies 的漿細胞稱 Mott cell（grape cell）；Russell bodies 可見於反應性（慢性發炎、感染）也可見於 myeloma 或淋巴漿細胞性淋巴瘤。
因 Russell bodies 不具 clonal 專一性，需以 kappa/lambda（flow 或 ISH）判斷 light-chain restriction，並配合 SPEP/free light chain。
對照：Dutcher body 覆蓋於核上、較傾向 clonal；兩者都是 Ig 堆積，差別在位置。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Dutcher bodies：Dutcher body 疊在核上；也別把 Russell bodies 當成細胞質空泡或吞噬物，Russell bodies 均質、有顏色且邊界清楚。

quiz.q: 箭頭漿細胞細胞質中的均質圓形小球稱為什麼？它們在哪個胞器中形成？
quiz.a: Russell bodies；擴張的 rough endoplasmic reticulum（含 immunoglobulin）

4064.recognize_zh: 這張皮膚免疫染色幾乎沒有棕色陽性訊號，只有蘇木紫複染；真皮血管與附屬器周圍的淋巴球團呈陰性，代表此標記在 T-PLL 皮膚浸潤細胞中為陰性（抗體名稱圖中未標示）。
features: Hematoxylin-counterstained skin section with no appreciable chromogen staining in the infiltrate
Dense perivascular and periadnexal dermal aggregates of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Superficial dermal infiltrate extending up to the dermoepidermal junction
Epidermis with mild acanthosis and orthokeratosis
Rare isolated red-brown dot in the dermis, likely nonspecific
4064.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a skin biopsy (antibody not specified) shows dense perivascular and periadnexal dermal aggregates of small-to-medium lymphoid cells that are essentially negative for the marker, with only hematoxylin counterstain visible. The infiltrate extends into the superficial dermis up to the dermoepidermal junction. The image documents a negative immunostain in the dermal infiltrate; its significance depends on the antibody used (for example, CD8, CD25 or a B-cell marker would be expected to be negative in T-prolymphocytic leukemia cutis).

ddx.vs: ATLL infiltrates are typically CD25-positive and HTLV-1 associated, whereas T-PLL is CD25-negative/TCL1-positive.
B-cell infiltrates would stain with CD20/PAX5, and CLL is CD23-positive; a negative T-cell-specific stain would not be expected in T-PLL.
A true negative requires positive internal or external controls, which are not evident in this field.

4000.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中白血球明顯增加，混有多顆單核球（monocyte）、成熟嗜中性球與有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），並有多染性紅血球；兒童出現單核球增多合併有核紅血球與未成熟細胞，應想到幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Leukocytosis with conspicuous monocytes showing folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Mature and band neutrophils admixed with occasional immature-appearing mononuclear cells
Several circulating nucleated red blood cells (small dense round nuclei)
Mild anisocytosis with scattered polychromatophilic and target-like red cells
Occasional small lymphocytes; platelets not prominent in this field
4000.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows increased leukocytes composed of monocytes, neutrophils and bands, with scattered nucleated red blood cells. Monocytes have lobulated or folded nuclei and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm; no significant population of blasts is evident in this field. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with polychromasia. In a young child, findings are suggestive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia; correlation with absolute monocyte count, hemoglobin F, and RAS-pathway mutation studies is required.

ddx.vs: CMML shows similar monocytosis but occurs in older adults, whereas JMML is a disease of young children with frequent NRBCs and elevated HbF.
CML has a myelocyte and neutrophil bulge with basophilia rather than prominent monocytosis, and is defined by BCR::ABL1 which is absent in JMML.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocytosis from viral infection (e.g., CMV, EBV)
ddx.vs: Infection-related monocytosis lacks persistent NRBCs and dysplasia and resolves; morphology alone may not separate them, so viral studies and RAS-pathway genetics are needed.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML shows at least 20% blasts including promonocytes, whereas JMML has fewer than 20% blasts in blood and marrow.

exam.answer_en: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) — pediatric blood smear with monocytosis, neutrophilia and circulating nucleated RBCs, no blast excess
pearls_zh: 考法：兒童周邊血單核球增多＋有核紅血球＋未成熟顆粒球，要能說出 JMML，並列出需排除的 CML（BCR::ABL1）與感染（EBV、CMV）。
診斷要素：周邊血 monocyte ≥1×10⁹/L、周邊血與骨髓 blast <20%、脾腫大、無 BCR::ABL1；年齡相對 HbF 上升是常考的輔助線索。
分子：約九成有 RAS 路徑突變——PTPN11、NRAS、KRAS、NF1、CBL；NF1 與 Noonan 症候群（PTPN11）是胚系關聯，常見伴 monosomy 7。
細胞生物學特徵：髓系前驅細胞對 GM-CSF 過度敏感（hypersensitivity），是經典考題。
治療：多數病例需異體造血幹細胞移植才可能治癒；部分 Noonan 相關或 germline CBL 病例可自行緩解，需與 JMML 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為成人 CMML 或 CML；JMML 發生在幼兒、常有 NRBC 與 HbF 上升，CML 則有 myelocyte 與 neutrophil 雙峰、嗜鹼球增加且 BCR::ABL1 陽性。

quiz.q: 幼兒抹片見單核球增多與有核紅血球，懷疑 JMML 時，其骨髓前驅細胞對哪一種生長因子呈過度敏感？
quiz.a: GM-CSF

3936.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片中真皮被瀰漫、單調的單核細胞浸潤取代，與表皮之間保留一條未受侵犯的窄帶（grenz zone），在急性單核球性白血病病人身上即為白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）。
features: Dense, diffuse, monotonous mononuclear cell infiltrate filling the dermis
Narrow uninvolved subepidermal grenz zone beneath intact epidermis
Infiltrating cells with oval to slightly irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Infiltrate dissecting between collagen bundles at the periphery
Residual adnexal structure entrapped without destruction
Cytologic detail limited at this low magnification
3936.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows an unremarkable epidermis overlying a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate of monotonous mononuclear cells separated from the epidermis by a thin grenz zone. The cells have oval to slightly irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm and infiltrate between collagen bundles, entrapping residual adnexal structures. Epidermotropism is not seen. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In a patient with acute monocytic leukemia, findings are consistent with leukemia cutis, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (e.g., CD68, lysozyme, CD163, MPO, CD34).

ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD20/PAX5 positive and lysozyme/CD68 negative, and may form nodular or follicular patterns, whereas myelomonocytic infiltrates express lysozyme, CD68 and CD163.
BPDCN also forms a dense dermal infiltrate with a grenz zone but is CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 positive and lysozyme/MPO negative.
Mycosis fungoides shows epidermotropism with atypical cerebriform lymphocytes, which is absent here, and T-cell markers are positive.
Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin, frequent mitoses and dot-like CK20 and neuroendocrine marker positivity.

3872.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染色下骨髓組織中布滿大量黑色、大小一致約 2–4 µm 的小型橢圓酵母菌，部分可見窄基出芽並成群聚集，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）感染。
features: Numerous small, uniform oval yeast forms stained black with GMS
Size approximately 2–4 µm with occasional narrow-based budding
Organisms clustered in groups consistent with intracellular location within histiocytes
Diffuse distribution throughout the marrow interstitium
No hyphae or pseudohyphae identified
Adipocyte spaces present in the green-counterstained background
