3872.describe_en: Grocott methenamine silver stain of the bone marrow biopsy highlights innumerable small, uniform, oval yeast forms measuring approximately 2–4 µm, many in clusters consistent with intracellular location, with occasional narrow-based budding. No hyphae or pseudohyphae are present. The organism burden is high and diffusely distributed in the marrow. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; correlation with urine/serum Histoplasma antigen and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Cryptococci are larger and more variable in size (4–10 µm or more) with a mucicarmine/Alcian blue positive capsule, unlike the small uniform Histoplasma yeasts.
C. glabrata yeasts are similar in size but are usually slightly larger, not tightly intracellular in histiocytes, and are distinguished by culture or molecular identification.
Pneumocystis cysts are cup- or crescent-shaped with intracystic dots and do not bud.
Talaromyces divides by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding, and has a travel history to Southeast Asia.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — GMS stain of marrow with innumerable small uniform 2-4 µm oval yeasts with narrow-based budding
pearls_zh: 考法：GMS 黑染的小酵母菌，考官問菌種並以「大小一致、2–4 µm、窄基出芽、多在組織球內」作答 Histoplasma capsulatum。
台灣考點：Talaromyces（Penicillium）marneffei 同為 2–4 µm 細胞內酵母樣菌，但以橫隔分裂（transverse septum）繁殖、不出芽，愛滋病人常見需鑑別。
確診工具：尿液／血清 Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高；骨髓與血液培養需時較長。瀰漫性感染多見於 HIV（CD4 低）、TNF 抑制劑或移植病人。
治療：中重度瀰漫性 histoplasmosis 以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，之後改 itraconazole 維持。
瀰漫性 histoplasmosis 是繼發性 HLH 的已知誘因，骨髓可同時看到吞噬現象。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Cryptococcus 混淆；Cryptococcus 較大且大小不一（約 4–10 µm 以上）、有 mucicarmine 陽性莢膜，Histoplasma 小而一致、無真正莢膜。

quiz.q: 圖中 GMS 染色的小型一致酵母菌若要與 Talaromyces marneffei 區分，最關鍵的繁殖形態差異是什麼？
quiz.a: Histoplasma 以窄基出芽（budding）繁殖；T. marneffei 以橫隔分裂（transverse septation/fission），不出芽

3488.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，占滿骨髓腔的單調細胞大多呈細緻的細胞膜（membranous）棕色染色，骨小樑為陰性，顯示腫瘤細胞廣泛浸潤；抗體名稱未標示，膜型分布可見於 CD138 等漿細胞標記。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of monotonous cells occupying the entire marrow space
Weak to moderate, predominantly membranous brown staining in most cells
Some cells show accentuated staining at cell junctions and focal cytoplasmic staining
Bony trabecula (lower left) negative
Antibody not specified in the image
3488.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate replacing the marrow space. The majority of cells show weak to moderate membranous staining with focal cytoplasmic accentuation, and the bony trabecula is negative. The antibody is not specified; the membranous pattern in nearly all cells is compatible with a plasma cell marker such as CD138. In context, findings support extensive marrow involvement by plasma cell myeloma, with light chain and IgD heavy chain stains required to show clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered interstitially or perivascularly in small numbers and are polytypic, not diffuse sheets.
DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5 positive and usually CD138 negative, whereas myeloma sheets are CD138 positive and CD20 negative.
CD138 can stain carcinomas, but carcinoma forms cohesive nests and is cytokeratin positive, so a keratin stain resolves the question.

3232.recognize_zh: 胸水細胞離心抹片中散在、互不黏聚的細胞，核偏心、染色質較細緻，細胞質深藍且有核旁淡染區（hof），部分細胞質拉出尾狀，呈現不成熟漿細胞的樣貌。
features: Discohesive medium-to-large cells scattered singly and in loose groups
Eccentric round-to-oval nuclei with relatively fine, finely granular chromatin
Moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear hof
Some cells with tapered, tail-like cytoplasmic extensions
Clean fluid background with scattered red cells, including occasional teardrop and crenated forms
3232.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows a population of discohesive plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, moderately fine chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing. The cells are relatively uniform and lack the coarse clock-face chromatin of mature plasma cells, indicating immaturity. No cohesive epithelial groups or mesothelial windows are seen. Findings are consistent with involvement of the pleural fluid by a plasma cell neoplasm; CD138 staining or flow cytometry with light-chain restriction is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, two-toned cytoplasm, peripheral brush borders and intercellular windows, and are calretinin/WT1+.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive groups, may contain mucin vacuoles indenting the nucleus, and are keratin+ CD138 variable but CD45/light-chain studies negative.
Lymphoma cells are larger with prominent nucleoli and markedly high proliferation, often EBV+, and usually lack a known myeloma with M-protein.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in inflammatory effusion
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature with clumped chromatin, admixed with abundant lymphocytes and neutrophils, and polytypic.

2976.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片顯示細胞密度高、脂肪稀少，骨小樑間充滿混合造血細胞並有出血；此倍率無法辨認噬血組織球，僅能作為背景評估。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat
Thin bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces filled by mixed hematopoietic cells
Areas of hemorrhage along the cortical surface
Histiocytes and hemophagocytosis not resolvable at low power
2976.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat between thin bony trabeculae and areas of hemorrhage. Cellular detail, including histiocytes or hemophagocytosis, cannot be assessed at this magnification. The finding of a hypercellular marrow is nonspecific; evaluation for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis requires high-power review, CD163 immunostaining and aspirate correlation.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia lacks histiocytic expansion with hemophagocytosis on high power and CD163 IHC.
Leukemia shows sheets of monotonous blasts on high power and CD34/flow confirmation.
MPN shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and fibrosis rather than a histiocytic infiltrate.

2784.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見數個較深染的淋巴聚集區，其中有淡棕色顆粒狀訊號，但染色很弱、生發中心結構在此張不易辨認；只能說骨髓內有多個淋巴聚集，需對照 H&E 與其他染色才能確認為生發中心。
features: Hypercellular marrow with several ill-defined darker lymphoid aggregates between fat spaces
Faint granular brown signal concentrated within the aggregates
Surrounding hematopoietic cells with occasional megakaryocytes
Germinal center zonation not clearly discernible at this magnification and stain intensity
Weak chromogen signal limits interpretation of the marker
2784.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power (apparently an immunohistochemical stain with weak brown chromogen; marker not labeled) shows hypercellular marrow containing several ill-defined lymphoid aggregates with faint granular staining concentrated within them. Megakaryocytes and other hematopoietic elements are present in the surrounding marrow. Well-formed germinal center architecture is not clearly appreciable in this image, and the weak signal limits interpretation. The findings are compatible with lymphoid aggregates corresponding to the reactive germinal centers shown in the H&E and CD20 images of this series.

ddx.vs: Paratrabecular aggregates with BCL2-positive follicle center cells would favor lymphoma; this cannot be assessed on this weakly stained low-power field.
Multiple nodular and intrasinusoidal monotypic B-cell aggregates favor marginal zone lymphoma; clonality studies are needed.
Mast cell aggregates are composed of spindle cells with clear cytoplasm, often paratrabecular with fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD117-positive.

2720.recognize_zh: 視野中央的淋巴球細胞質邊緣可見數顆粉紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核染色質濃縮、細胞質量中等，這就是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）的樣子。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte, roughly 1.5 times a red cell diameter
Round-to-oval nucleus with condensed chromatin, no visible nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Several coarse pink-purple azurophilic granules along the cytoplasmic rim
Background normochromic red cells with a few platelets
2720.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-intermediate power shows normochromic red cells and scattered platelets. A medium-sized lymphocyte with condensed nuclear chromatin and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm contains several coarse azurophilic granules. No blasts or nucleolated atypical lymphoid cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; in the appropriate count context this supports an LGL (NK-cell) lymphocytosis, and immunophenotyping is needed to assign NK versus T lineage and clonality.

ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate T-LGL from NK-LGL; flow cytometry (surface CD3 and TCR expression) and TCR gene rearrangement studies are required.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows larger atypical cells with open chromatin, visible nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm, usually EBV-positive in a sick patient.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and fine dust-like rather than coarse discrete granules.

2528.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞量高，混合各階段顆粒球、紅血球前驅細胞，並散布許多核染色質細緻、胞質深藍的原始細胞（blasts），提示伴過量原始細胞的 MDS（MDS-EB／RAEB）。
features: Cellular marrow smear with mixed myeloid and erythroid precursors
Increased blasts: intermediate cells with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Segmented neutrophils and bands, some appearing hypogranular at this resolution
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and deep blue cytoplasm
Resolution limits assessment of subtle dyspoietic features and precise blast count
2528.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a cellular specimen with trilineage precursors and an apparent increase in blasts, which are intermediate-sized cells with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytes, some appearing hypogranular, and erythroid precursors are present. Subtle dysplastic features and an exact blast percentage cannot be determined at this resolution and require a 500-cell differential. Findings are suggestive of myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: AML requires at least 20% blasts in blood or marrow (or a defining genetic abnormality), whereas MDS-EB has 5-19% marrow blasts by manual count.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow after chemotherapy or G-CSF
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronous wave of promyelocytes with a clinical history of therapy and lacks persistent dysplasia or clonal cytogenetics.
CMML requires persistent peripheral monocytosis of at least 0.5 x 10^9/L and at least 10% monocytes, not seen in MDS-EB.

2400.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中造血細胞以圓核、顆粒細胞質的顆粒球前驅細胞為主，並有多數成熟嗜中性球，中央有一顆細胞質豐富、核偏位的大型細胞；整體是細胞量增加且持續成熟的再生骨髓樣貌。
features: Moderately cellular aspirate trails with numerous granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes/myelocytes)
Maturing neutrophils (bands and segmented forms) and erythroid precursors present
Central large cell with abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm and an eccentric nucleus, possibly an immature megakaryocyte or osteoblast (not resolvable at this power)
No sheets of blasts evident
Background of crenated red cells
2400.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows cellular trails composed predominantly of granulocytic precursors, including promyelocytes and myelocytes, with continued maturation to bands and segmented neutrophils and scattered erythroid precursors. A large cell with abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm and an eccentric nucleus is present centrally; its lineage cannot be determined with certainty at this magnification. There is no apparent sheet-like increase in blasts. Findings are consistent with a regenerating, recovering bone marrow; blast enumeration and clinical correlation are needed.

ddx.vs: Residual leukemia shows a clustered, monotonous population of agranular blasts rather than a mix of granulated precursors maturing to neutrophils.
CML is associated with basophilia, eosinophilia, dwarf megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 rather than a transient post-therapy regenerative wave.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow from infection or G-CSF
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely; toxic granulation or clinical history of G-CSF versus chemotherapy recovery separates them.

2080.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆嗜中性球的細胞核分成至少六葉（lobe），各葉之間以細絲相連，這就是過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil）的特徵。
features: Single segmented neutrophil with at least six discrete nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Coarse clumped chromatin in each lobe; pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Cell is of normal to slightly large neutrophil size
Background red cells are mostly round with central pallor; no obvious marked macro-ovalocytosis in this field
No inclusions (Döhle bodies, toxic granulation) evident
2080.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with at least six nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments, with otherwise unremarkable granular cytoplasm. Surrounding red cells are largely normochromic with central pallor, and marked macro-ovalocytosis is not evident in this field. Hypersegmentation is defined as any neutrophil with six or more lobes or more than 5% of neutrophils with five lobes. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil, most commonly associated with megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils usually have 2 to 4 lobes, whereas this cell has six or more.
The hereditary form involves most neutrophils in an otherwise healthy person with normal B12/folate and no macrocytosis, and requires clinical correlation to separate.

ddx.dx: Hypersegmentation from drugs or myelodysplasia (e.g. methotrexate, hydroxyurea, MDS)
ddx.vs: These are indistinguishable morphologically on a single cell and require medication history, vitamin levels and marrow evaluation.

exam.answer_en: Hypersegmented neutrophil (≥6 lobes) — hallmark of megaloblastic anemia from vitamin B12 or folate deficiency
pearls_zh: 考法：考官要你數葉數；定義為任一嗜中性球 ≥6 葉，或 5 葉者 >5%。
過度分葉可早於巨球性紅血球出現，也可在合併缺鐵時被掩蓋 MCV 上升，是巨母細胞性貧血的敏感線索。
檢查：B12、folate；邊界值時測 methylmalonic acid（B12 缺乏時升高）與 homocysteine（兩者缺乏皆升高）；pernicious anemia 查 anti-intrinsic factor 抗體。
治療原則：未排除 B12 缺乏前不可單補 folate，否則血液學改善但神經學病變可能惡化。
其他原因：methotrexate、hydroxyurea 等抗代謝藥、MDS，以及罕見遺傳性過度分葉。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把兩顆重疊的嗜中性球或核碎裂的凋亡細胞誤數為過度分葉：須確認為單一細胞、葉間以細絲相連，並判讀全片比例而非單一細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球核分成至少六葉，最常見的病因是什麼？補充治療時要注意什麼？
quiz.a: Vitamin B12 或 folate 缺乏（巨母細胞性貧血）；排除 B12 缺乏前勿單補 folate

2016.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被膜下可見兩個生發中心增大的反應性濾泡，濾泡之間與周圍散布淡粉紅色、界線不清的小團類上皮組織球，部分貼近生發中心邊緣，符合弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的表現。
features: Lymph node with thin capsule and perinodal adipose tissue at the bottom
Two reactive follicles with enlarged germinal centers and preserved mantle zones
Small ill-defined pale eosinophilic clusters of epithelioid histiocytes in interfollicular tissue
Epithelioid clusters abut the edges of germinal centers
Paler cellular zones beneath the capsule, possibly monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
No necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
2016.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at low-intermediate power shows a thin capsule with perinodal fat and two reactive follicles with enlarged germinal centers. The interfollicular areas contain numerous small, ill-defined clusters of epithelioid histiocytes, some abutting germinal centers, and paler zones beneath the capsule suggest monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia. There is no necrosis and no giant cells. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: These produce larger coalescent granulomas with central necrosis and giant cells rather than tiny scattered epithelioid clusters.
Plain follicular hyperplasia lacks the interfollicular epithelioid histiocyte clusters that encroach on germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphoma with epithelioid histiocytes
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows architectural effacement by a monotonous clonal population with light chain restriction, not preserved reactive follicles.

exam.answer_en: Toxoplasma lymphadenitis — reactive follicles with epithelioid histiocyte clusters abutting germinal centers and subcapsular monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著貼在生發中心邊緣的淡染小團問「這個位置關係有何意義？」答：epithelioid histiocytes 侵入或緊貼 germinal center，是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的特徵性線索。
被膜下淡染區為 monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia：細胞質淡而豐富，位於竇周；此反應也見於 HIV、cat-scratch disease 早期。
IHC 輔助：CD68/CD163 標示組織球團；濾泡 BCL2 陰性、kappa/lambda polytypic 可支持反應性而非淋巴瘤。
常見於年輕人後頸部單側淋巴結腫大；血清 Toxoplasma IgM 陽性或 IgG 低 avidity 支持近期感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易當成單純 reactive follicular hyperplasia 而漏診：一般反應性增生缺少濾泡間散布、侵入生發中心的上皮樣組織球小叢，看到小叢應提醒送弓漿蟲血清學。

quiz.q: 被膜下淡染的細胞區代表哪一種反應性增生？
quiz.a: Monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia

1952.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組化染色（抗體未標示）中，可見多個不規則、地圖狀的淡棕色區塊，被含散在深色細胞核的淡藍綠色間質分隔；影像對比度與解析度低，只能看出染色呈不規則擴張的區域性分布，難以精確判讀。
features: Very low-power IHC with multiple irregular, geographic tan-staining zones
Zones separated by paler blue-green areas containing scattered dark nuclei
Irregular shapes and variable sizes of the stained zones rather than round, discrete follicles
Low contrast and resolution preclude assessment of the staining pattern at the cellular level
1952.describe_en: Very low-power immunohistochemical stain (antibody not labeled) of a lymph node shows multiple irregular, geographic tan-staining zones of variable size separated by paler areas with scattered hematoxylin-stained nuclei. The stained zones are irregular rather than round and discrete. Owing to low contrast and resolution, the cellular localization of staining cannot be assessed and the antibody cannot be inferred with confidence. If this represents a follicular dendritic cell marker such as CD21 or CD23, the irregular expanded pattern would support angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FDC markers in reactive nodes highlight compact, round, well-circumscribed meshworks confined to germinal centers.
Follicular lymphoma shows crowded, back-to-back round FDC meshworks within neoplastic follicles that are BCL2-positive B-cell nodules.
FDC sarcoma forms sheets and whorls of atypical spindle to ovoid cells with CD21/CD23/CD35 positivity, not expanded meshworks among lymphoid cells.

1760.recognize_zh: 低倍Ki-1（CD30）免疫染色中，棕色陽性的大細胞沿著淋巴結竇道與濾泡間區呈帶狀、網狀分布，包圍中間藍色陰性的淋巴區域，是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤竇內浸潤的特徵。
features: Low-power immunostain labeled 'Ki-1' (the original name of CD30)
Strongly positive brown cells arranged in anastomosing bands and cords consistent with sinusoidal and interfollicular distribution
Negative intervening lymphoid compartments with blue counterstain
Dense confluent positive areas at lower right with scattered single positive cells elsewhere
Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
1760.describe_en: Low-power Ki-1 (CD30) immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows strongly positive cells arranged in anastomosing bands tracking along sinuses and interfollicular areas, surrounding negative lymphoid compartments. Confluent aggregates of positive cells are present at the lower right. Cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The sinusoidal distribution of strongly CD30-positive cells is characteristic. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, historically termed Ki-1 lymphoma; ALK immunostaining is recommended for subclassification.

ddx.vs: CD30-positive Hodgkin cells are scattered singly within nodules or a mixed background rather than filling sinuses in continuous bands.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia with CD30-positive immunoblasts
ddx.vs: Reactive immunoblasts are sparse, weaker, and interfollicular rather than forming dense sinus-filling aggregates.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30 positive but is also keratin, OCT4, and SALL4 positive and CD45 negative.

1696.recognize_zh: 這是胸部 X 光正面（PA）與側面影像，不是型態學圖片；在 ALL（尤其 T-ALL）評估時，重點是看縱膈是否變寬、有無前縱膈腫塊或肋膜積液，本圖解析度下縱膈輪廓僅可疑變寬。
features: Paired posteroanterior and lateral chest radiographs
Superior mediastinal contour appears mildly prominent on the PA view; no definite large discrete mass at this resolution
Lung fields without obvious consolidation
Costophrenic angles not clearly blunted; no large pleural effusion evident
Lateral view retrosternal space without an unequivocal anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass
1696.describe_en: Posteroanterior and lateral chest radiographs are shown. The superior mediastinum appears mildly prominent on the frontal view, but a large discrete anterior mediastinal mass is not unequivocally demonstrated at this image resolution, and there is no obvious consolidation or large pleural effusion. In acute lymphoblastic leukemia, chest imaging is used to screen for a mediastinal (thymic) mass, which is characteristic of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma and carries a risk of airway and superior vena cava compromise during sedation. Interpretation here should be confirmed with the formal radiology report or CT.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic lymphoma with anterior mediastinal mass
ddx.vs: A true thymic mass produces a lobulated mediastinal widening on PA and filling of the retrosternal clear space on the lateral view, which is not clearly present here.
Also presents as an anterior mediastinal mass in young patients but is diagnosed by tissue biopsy showing Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, not by marrow blasts.
Radiologically similar bulky anterior mass; distinguished histologically by sheets of large B cells with sclerosis and CD23/MAL expression.

1632.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區（paracortex）中可見斜行的高內皮小靜脈（high endothelial venule, HEV），內襯飽滿立方狀內皮細胞，管壁內外有小淋巴球穿越，背景混有較大、核較淡的細胞，符合正常副皮質區。
features: Postcapillary venules lined by plump cuboidal endothelial cells with oval vesicular nuclei (high endothelial venules)
Small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin within and around the venule walls (transmigration)
Scattered larger cells with pale oval to folded nuclei and ample pale cytoplasm (interdigitating dendritic cells/histiocytes or immunoblasts)
Mixed, non-monotonous cell population without sheets of atypical cells
No follicle or germinal center in this field
1632.describe_en: Section of lymph node at high power shows paracortical tissue composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes admixed with scattered larger cells with pale, oval to folded nuclei. Several high endothelial venules lined by plump cuboidal endothelium are present, with lymphocytes traversing their walls. There is no monotonous atypical population, necrosis, or granuloma in this field. Findings are consistent with normal lymph node paracortex with high endothelial venules.

ddx.vs: AITL shows arborizing HEV proliferation with clear-cell atypical T cells, effaced architecture and expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks, whereas here the venules are ordinary and the lymphocytes are small and bland.
Reactive paracortical hyperplasia shows many more immunoblasts and a mottled expansion at low power, which cannot be judged in this single high-power field.
Dermatopathic change shows pale nodules of Langerhans and interdigitating cells with melanin-laden macrophages, not seen here.

1440.recognize_zh: 雙格骨髓抹片以紅系前驅細胞為主：可見大型、胞質深藍、染色質細顆粒的前紅血球母細胞與嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞，部分核質成熟不同步（megaloblastoid），混有顆粒球；這些是紅系異常增生的表現，但環狀鐵粒母細胞需靠鐵染色才能看到，本圖無法確認。
features: Two-panel composite of bone marrow aspirate fields
Erythroid predominance with large proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts showing deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely granular, open chromatin suggesting megaloblastoid maturation
Polychromatophilic erythroblasts and admixed granulocytic cells including band forms
No iron stain shown; ring sideroblasts not visible on this stain
1440.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate composite shows erythroid predominance with numerous proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts containing deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with finely granular, somewhat open chromatin, suggesting megaloblastoid maturation. Polychromatophilic erythroblasts and granulocytic cells, including band forms, are also present. These findings indicate erythroid hyperplasia with dyserythropoiesis. Classification as MDS with ring sideroblasts requires a Prussian blue stain demonstrating ring sideroblasts, which is not shown.

ddx.vs: True megaloblastic change shows striking nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils and corrects with B12/folate.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires over 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts, typically with TP53 mutation.
Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows orderly maturation without dysplasia or ring sideroblasts, with evidence of hemolysis.

61856.recognize_zh: 骨小樑（左側粉紅色骨質）旁的造血組織中，貼著骨小樑的區域有一群核圓至卵圓、細胞質呈粉紅顆粒狀的未成熟骨髓系細胞（myelocytes），下方可見細胞質鮮紅顆粒的嗜酸性球，右側則有核小而深染的紅血球前驅細胞。
features: Bone trabecula on the left with a paratrabecular band of hematopoietic cells and adjacent fat spaces
Paratrabecular immature myeloid cells with round to oval or slightly indented vesicular nuclei and moderate granular eosinophilic cytoplasm
Two cells near the bottom with bright red coarse cytoplasmic granules, consistent with eosinophils/eosinophilic precursors
Right side shows clusters of cells with small, round, dense hyperchromatic nuclei, consistent with erythroid precursors
Elongated spindle nuclei lining the trabecular surface (osteoblasts/stromal cells); no atypical infiltrate
61856.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula with adjacent trilineage hematopoietic marrow and fat. The paratrabecular zone contains a band of immature myeloid cells, including myelocytes with round to oval vesicular nuclei and moderate granular eosinophilic cytoplasm, in keeping with the normal paratrabecular localization of early granulopoiesis. Two eosinophilic forms with bright red granules are present near the bottom, and erythroid precursors with small round dense nuclei are clustered toward the right. No abnormal infiltrate, fibrosis or atypical localization of immature precursors is identified. Findings are consistent with normal paratrabecular myeloid maturation.

ddx.vs: ALIP refers to clusters of blasts/promyelocytes located centrally away from trabeculae, whereas these maturing myeloid cells are appropriately paratrabecular.
Plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei with a perinuclear hof and amphophilic cytoplasm rather than granular eosinophilic cytoplasm; CD138 confirms.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular aggregates of spindled mast cells with clear to pale cytoplasm, often with fibrosis and admixed eosinophils, confirmed by tryptase/CD117/CD25.

96.recognize_zh: 同一顆淋巴結中可見由小淋巴球構成的模糊結節、散在具泡狀核與明顯核仁的大型 LP 細胞，以及小 B 細胞稀少、大型 B 細胞散布於 T 細胞背景的 THRLBCL 樣區域；另有大型 B 細胞成片生長區（免疫染色膜狀強陽性），提示 NLPHL 合併變異型態並轉化為 DLBCL。
features: Vaguely nodular to diffuse architecture with serpiginous nodules and pale histiocyte-rich zones at low power
Scattered large LP-type cells with vesicular, lobated nuclei and small-to-moderate nucleoli in a background of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes

IHC (antigens not labeled in figures): membrane-positive large cells scattered within positive small-B-cell nodules and, elsewhere, within a largely negative small-cell background (THRLBCL-like pattern)
Areas where positive small cells are depleted and large positive cells lie singly among negative small lymphocytes, some with rosetting
Confluent sheets of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and mitoses, showing uniform membranous positivity (DLBCL component)
Abrupt transition from scattered large positive cells to sheet-like growth in one field
96.describe_en: Sections of the axillary lymph node show architectural effacement with a spectrum of patterns, ranging from vaguely nodular, serpiginous areas composed of small lymphocytes and histiocytes to diffuse areas with pale histiocyte-rich zones. At high power, scattered large atypical cells with vesicular, lobulated nuclei and distinct nucleoli are present in a background of small lymphocytes. Immunostains (antigens not labeled in these figures) highlight large neoplastic cells in variable settings: within nodules rich in positive small cells, as scattered cells in extranodular locations, and as isolated large cells in a background depleted of positive small cells, resembling T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma. Other areas show confluent sheets of large pleomorphic cells with prominent nucleoli and mitoses that are uniformly membrane-positive, with an abrupt transition from the scattered-cell pattern. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with typical and variant patterns and transformation to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; the specific antigens should be confirmed from the stain labels.

ddx.vs: De novo THRLBCL shows a diffuse pattern with near-absent small B cells and no residual NLPHL nodules, whereas this node retains nodules containing numerous small B cells around the large cells.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/OCT2/BOB1, while LP cells are CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+ and CD30/CD15 negative.
PTGC nodules contain mantle B cells and centroblasts but lack LP cells and the extranodular or diffuse large-cell spread seen here.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma with large cell transformation
ddx.vs: FL shows back-to-back neoplastic follicles of centrocytes and centroblasts with BCL2 and CD10 expression, rather than scattered LP cells ringed by PD1+ T cells in a small-B-cell-rich meshwork.

96.stain: H&E; IHC (antigens not labeled in figures)
captions: H&E, high power: small lymphocytes and histiocytes with scattered large cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli
H&E, low power: vaguely nodular to diffuse architecture with pale histiocyte-rich zones
H&E, low power: serpiginous nodules of pale larger cells and histiocytes rimmed by dark small lymphocytes
H&E, low power: vague nodular pattern of small lymphocytes
IHC (red, membranous): nodule rich in positive small cells containing larger positive cells
IHC (brown): large atypical cells with membranous-cytoplasmic staining among small lymphocytes
IHC (red, nuclear): scattered positive nuclei of variable size in a small-cell background
IHC (red, membranous): scattered large positive cells in a negative small-lymphocyte background
IHC (brown, granular cytoplasmic/membranous): scattered large cells positive, small lymphocytes negative
IHC (red): rare single positive cell; large and small cells otherwise negative
IHC (red, membranous): scattered large positive cells among negative small lymphocytes
IHC (red), low power: positive cells arranged in irregular nodular aggregates separated by negative zones
IHC (red), low power: nodular area of positive small cells with scattered positive large cells
H&E, low power: diffuse pattern with pale histiocyte-rich areas
H&E, medium power: diffuse small lymphocytes with scattered large cells and histiocytes
IHC (red), low power: scattered large positive cells in a predominantly negative background (THRLBCL-like)
IHC (red): numerous scattered large membrane-positive cells with few positive small cells
IHC (red): scattered large membrane-positive cells increasing in density toward one side
IHC (red), low power: widespread positive cells throughout a diffuse area
H&E, high power: sheets of large pleomorphic cells with prominent nucleoli and mitoses (DLBCL component)
IHC (red), low power: transition from scattered positive large cells to confluent sheets of positive cells
IHC (red), high power: sheets of large cells with strong membranous positivity (DLBCL component)

exam.answer_en: NLPHL with typical and variant (THRLBCL-like) patterns transforming to DLBCL — scattered LP cells in nodules, then confluent sheets of large B cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指泡狀、分葉核（popcorn）大型 LP 細胞，或指成片大 B 細胞區，問「哪一區是轉化」——判準是大細胞融合成片。
LP 細胞表型：CD20+、CD79a+、PAX5+、OCT2/BOB1 強陽性、BCL6+、CD45+，CD30−、CD15−；周圍有 PD-1+/CD57+ T 細胞 rosettes。
Fan 分型：A（B 細胞豐富結節）、B（serpiginous）為典型；C–F 為變異型，E 為 THRLBCL-like、F 為瀰漫 B 細胞豐富。變異型與較高復發/轉化風險相關。
ICC 2022 將 NLPHL 改稱 nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma；WHO 5th 仍保留 NLPHL 名稱。
轉化為 DLBCL 時治療依 DLBCL（如 R-CHOP 類），不再按 Hodgkin 處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: E 型區域易誤診為原發 THRLBCL：只要同一淋巴結找到含小 B 細胞與 FDC 網的典型 NLPHL 結節，就應歸為 NLPHL 變異型態而非 de novo THRLBCL。

quiz.q: 大型 B 細胞散在於 T 細胞背景、小 B 細胞缺乏的區域相當於 NLPHL 的哪種 Fan pattern？
quiz.a: Pattern E（THRLBCL-like）

61664.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下，富細胞性骨髓只剩少量脂肪空泡，黑色細網狀纖維在細胞間形成連續交叉的網絡，上方並有較粗纖維束；符合真性紅血球增多症（polycythemia vera）增生期骨髓伴輕度網狀纖維增加。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat spaces
Panmyelosis pattern of densely packed hematopoietic cells (nuclei in magenta counterstain)
Loose network of thin reticulin fibers with many intersections throughout the interstitium
Focal coarser, parallel fiber bundles in the upper field, some around vessels
No collagen-type thick bands or osteosclerosis appreciable in this field
61664.describe_en: Reticulin stain of a bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced adipocytes. There is a loose network of thin reticulin fibers with numerous intersections throughout the hematopoietic areas, with focal coarser fiber bundles, most prominently in perivascular areas; this corresponds to approximately MF-1, focally approaching MF-2. Individual megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed reliably on this silver stain. In the appropriate clinical and molecular context (JAK2 mutation, elevated hemoglobin), findings are consistent with polycythemia vera, with mild reticulin fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Requires grade 2–3 fibrosis (dense fibers with extensive intersections and collagen bundles), which exceeds the predominantly loose network seen here.
Shows atypical, cloud-like hyperchromatic megakaryocytes with granulocytic proliferation and reduced erythropoiesis, and lacks the erythrocytosis of PV.
Marrow is usually normocellular with large staghorn megakaryocytes and usually no significant reticulin increase.
Shows isolated erythroid hyperplasia without panmyelosis, megakaryocytic clustering, or increased reticulin, and lacks JAK2 mutation.

60064.recognize_zh: 抹片紅血球大小與形狀差異極大（淚滴狀、橢圓、碎片），並可見多顆紅血球內有粗大的嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling），加上一顆有核紅血球；這種明顯異形與點彩的組合，符合先天性鐵粒幼紅血球貧血的周邊血象。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes, elongated and fragmented forms
Coarse basophilic stippling in several red cells
Dimorphic red cell population with a subset of hypochromic microcytes alongside normochromic cells
Single nucleated cell with a dense round nucleus and thin rim of cytoplasm, consistent with a nucleated red cell (small lymphocyte is the look-alike)
Platelets present, including a small clump; no white cell abnormality evident
60064.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells, elliptocytes, and irregular fragmented forms, and a dimorphic population including hypochromic microcytes. Several red cells contain coarse basophilic stippling, and a nucleated cell with a dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm is most consistent with a nucleated red blood cell. Platelets are present and adequate on this field. In the context of a congenital microcytic anemia with ring sideroblasts in the marrow, findings are consistent with congenital sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Also shows stippling, nRBCs, and poikilocytosis, but has abundant target cells and elevated HbF/HbA2 without ring sideroblasts.
Shows coarse basophilic stippling with mild microcytosis, but not a dimorphic population with marked poikilocytosis, and blood lead is elevated.
Shows teardrop cells and nRBCs in a leukoerythroblastic picture with immature granulocytes and splenomegaly rather than congenital microcytosis.
Features prominent basophilic stippling with hemolysis but normocytic red cells and no ring sideroblasts.

3616.recognize_zh: 兩顆中性球的胞質內各可見一團緊密、細顆粒狀的紫色小圓形包涵體（桑椹體 morula），緊鄰核旁或位於細胞一端；中性球內的桑椹體最符合顆粒球性無形體症（Anaplasma phagocytophilum，舊稱人類顆粒球性艾利希體症）。
features: Two neutrophils, each containing a small round, stippled, purple cytoplasmic inclusion (morula)
Left neutrophil: morula adjacent to the nuclear lobes; right neutrophil: morula at one pole of an elongated cell
Neutrophil nuclei segmented to band-like with otherwise unremarkable granulation
Background echinocytes (crenated red cells), likely artifactual, and scattered platelets
3616.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils, each containing a small, round, finely stippled basophilic-to-purple cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a morula. The inclusions lie adjacent to the nucleus in one cell and at one pole of the other cell, and neutrophil granulation is otherwise unremarkable. Background red cells show crenation, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with infection by an intracellular Anaplasmataceae organism in granulocytes (Anaplasma phagocytophilum, or Ehrlichia ewingii); PCR confirmation is recommended because morulae are seen in only a minority of cases.

ddx.vs: E. chaffeensis morulae are found mainly in monocytes rather than neutrophils, and species is confirmed by PCR.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, homogeneous and located at the cell periphery, not dense stippled purple clusters.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed bacteria or platelets overlying neutrophils
ddx.vs: Ingested cocci are discrete, separate dots, and overlying platelets extend beyond the cell membrane with a pale hyalomere.
Histoplasma forms oval yeasts with a clear halo rather than granular clusters.

exam.answer_en: Granulocytic ehrlichiosis/anaplasmosis — stippled purple morulae within neutrophil cytoplasm (Anaplasma phagocytophilum or Ehrlichia ewingii)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中性球內的桑椹狀紫色小團，問名稱與病原；答 morula。中性球內多為 Anaplasma phagocytophilum（或 E. ewingii），單核球內則為 E. chaffeensis。
抹片看到 morulae 的敏感度有限，急性期首選 whole blood PCR；血清學需急性期與恢復期雙套 IFA 抗體上升才能確認。
典型實驗室變化：白血球低下、血小板低下與肝酵素升高，病人有壁蝨暴露史與發燒。
治療：懷疑時即經驗性給予 doxycycline，成人與兒童皆為首選，不需等待確診。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Döhle body、毒性顆粒或疊在細胞上的血小板；Döhle body 淡藍均質且位於胞質邊緣，morula 為緊密點狀紫色團塊，血小板則會超出細胞膜並有淡色 hyalomere。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球內的包涵體叫什麼？首選治療藥物為何？
quiz.a: Morula；doxycycline
